1→//! Scribe actor state and configuration types
     2→//!
     3→//! Contains all state structs, type aliases, and configuration for the Scribe actor.
     4→
     5→use std::collections::HashMap;
     6→use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, RwLock};
     7→
     8→use tokio::sync::mpsc;
     9→
    10→use domains::{Layer, QuerySpec, QueryResult, QueryDelta};
    11→
    12→use crate::layer_unit::LayerUnit;
    13→use crate::{
    14→    BroadcastPayload, EphemeralOutbound, PageUpdate, SyncEvent,
    15→    LayerStorageRef, PeerVectorStorageRef, PeerResolverRef, PermitIssuerRef,
    16→};
    17→
    18→// Layer Name Normalization
    19→
    20→/// Normalize a layer name by stripping `{page_id}/` prefix if present
    21→///
    22→/// **Context**: Lua apps and wire protocol use prefixed names (`{page_id}/messages`)
    23→/// but Scribe stores layers with bare names (`messages`). This strips the prefix
    24→/// at the Scribe boundary so all internal lookups use consistent bare names.
    25→pub fn normalize_layer_name(name: &str, page_id: &str) -> String {
    26→    let prefix = format!("{}/", page_id);
    27→    if let Some(bare) = name.strip_prefix(&prefix) {
    28→        bare.to_string()
    29→    } else {
    30→        name.to_string()
    31→    }
    32→}
    33→
    34→// Sync Configuration
    35→
    36→/// Sync mode derived from permit capabilities
    37→///
    38→/// **Design**: Capability-based, not role-based
    39→/// - Mode is derived from permit's sync configuration
    40→/// - No hardcoded role names in decision logic
    41→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    42→pub enum SyncMode {
    43→    /// Sync to a specific source node (users sync to their node)
    44→    ToSource,
    45→    /// Broadcast to all authorized peers (node mode)
    46→    Broadcast,
    47→}
    48→
    49→impl Default for SyncMode {
    50→    fn default() -> Self {
    51→        SyncMode::Broadcast
    52→    }
    53→}
    54→
    55→/// Sync configuration derived from permit
    56→///
    57→/// **Context**: Determines how this Scribe syncs based on permit capabilities
    58→/// - ToSource: Sync to a specific source node (owner/viewer/customer)
    59→/// - Broadcast: Broadcast to all authorized peers (node)
    60→#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    61→pub struct SyncConfig {
    62→    /// Sync mode derived from permit (capability-based)
    63→    pub mode: SyncMode,
    64→    /// For ToSource: node_id to sync to
    65→    /// For Broadcast: None (uses list_authorized_users callback)
    66→    pub sync_target: Option<String>,
    67→}
    68→
    69→// Subscriber Types
    70→
    71→/// Information about a subscribed peer
    72→///
    73→/// **Design**: Stores the parsed permit directly instead of extracted fields.
    74→/// All access checks delegate to gurkha::Permit methods, ensuring consistency.
    75→pub struct SubscriberInfo {
    76→    /// Parsed page permit for all access checks (static layers)
    77→    /// Stores the full permit so we can use its methods directly
    78→    pub permit: gurkha::Permit,
    79→    /// Layer permits (dynamic layers) — additive, one per dynamic layer
    80→    pub layer_permits: Vec<gurkha::Permit>,
    81→    /// Subscriber's DID (for pattern expansion with {aud})
    82→    /// Extracted from permit audience and normalized to DID format
    83→    pub subscriber_did: String,
    84→    /// Whether this subscriber is visible (from permit presence config)
    85→    /// Visible peers have their entry written to the presence layer
    86→    pub is_visible: bool,
    87→    /// Whether this subscriber can see others' presence
    88→    /// Gates whether the presence layer is synced to this peer
    89→    pub can_see_others: bool,
    90→    /// Display name for this subscriber (from permit presence config)
    91→    pub display_name: Option<String>,
    92→    /// Channel to send CRDT broadcasts
    93→    pub broadcast_tx: mpsc::Sender<BroadcastPayload>,
    94→    /// Channel to send ephemeral broadcasts (cursor, typing)
    95→    /// PeerActor creates this, spawns listener that sends datagrams
    96→    pub ephemeral_tx: Option<mpsc::Sender<EphemeralOutbound>>,
    97→    /// Their last known state vectors (layer_name → version_vector)
    98→    pub vectors: HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
    99→}
   100→
   101→impl SubscriberInfo {
   102→    /// Check if subscriber can receive updates for layer (two-tier)
   103→    ///
   104→    /// **Context**: Used during broadcast/reconciliation to check read permission
   105→    /// **Two-tier**: Checks page permit (static layers) then layer permits (dynamic layers)
   106→    pub fn can_receive_layer(&self, layer_name: &str, page_id: &str) -> bool {
   107→        // Block presence layer for peers who can't see others
   108→        if (layer_name == "presence" || layer_name.ends_with("/presence")) && !self.can_see_others {
   109→            return false;
   110→        }
   111→        // Check if layer is in no_incoming_updates (sync facts)
   112→        if self.permit.sync_facts().no_incoming_updates.contains(&layer_name.to_string()) {
   113→            return false;
   114→        }
   115→        // Two-tier check: page permit OR any layer permit
   116→        gurkha::can_access_with_layer_permits(
   117→            &self.permit, &self.layer_permits,
   118→            layer_name, page_id, &self.subscriber_did, "read",
   119→        )
   120→    }
   121→
   122→    /// Check if subscriber can write to layer (two-tier)
   123→    ///
   124→    /// **Context**: Used during incoming update validation
   125→    /// **Two-tier**: Checks page permit then layer permits
   126→    pub fn can_write_layer(&self, layer_name: &str, page_id: &str) -> bool {
   127→        gurkha::can_access_with_layer_permits(
   128→            &self.permit, &self.layer_permits,
   129→            layer_name, page_id, &self.subscriber_did, "write",
   130→        )
   131→    }
   132→
   133→    /// Add a layer permit (additive, no replacement)
   134→    ///
   135→    /// **Context**: Node issued a new layer permit for a dynamic layer
   136→    pub fn add_layer_permit(&mut self, permit: gurkha::Permit) {
   137→        self.layer_permits.push(permit);
   138→    }
   139→}
   140→
   141→/// Query subscription info
   142→pub struct QuerySubscriberInfo {
   143→    /// Query specification
   144→    pub spec: QuerySpec,
   145→    /// Channel to send deltas
   146→    pub delta_tx: mpsc::Sender<QueryDelta>,
   147→    /// Current version (monotonically increasing)
   148→    pub version: u64,
   149→    /// Last known result (for computing deltas)
   150→    pub last_result: Option<QueryResult>,
   151→}
   152→
   153→// Actor State
   154→
   155→/// Scribe actor state
   156→pub struct ScribeState {
   157→    /// Page identifier
   158→    pub page_id: String,
   159→    /// Per-layer compute units (layer_name → LayerUnit)
   160→    pub units: HashMap<String, LayerUnit>,
   161→    /// Peer subscribers (user_did, device_id) → SubscriberInfo
   162→    /// Arc<RwLock> allows Loro observer callback to send directly to peers
   163→    pub subscribers: Arc<RwLock<HashMap<(String, String), SubscriberInfo>>>,
   164→    /// Query subscribers (query_id → QuerySubscriberInfo)
   165→    pub query_subscribers: HashMap<String, QuerySubscriberInfo>,
   166→
   167→    /// Layer persistence (saves layer snapshots)
   168→    pub layer_storage: LayerStorageRef,
   169→    /// Peer vector persistence (saves/loads peer state vectors)
   170→    pub vector_storage: PeerVectorStorageRef,
   171→    /// Peer resolver (node mode only) - lists authorized users, loads permits
   172→    pub peer_resolver: Option<PeerResolverRef>,
   173→    /// Permit issuer (node mode only) - issues layer permits for dynamic layers
   174→    pub permit_issuer: Option<PermitIssuerRef>,
   175→
   176→    /// Sync configuration derived from permit (mode + sync_target)
   177→    pub sync_config: Option<SyncConfig>,
   178→    /// Channel to emit sync events (EnsureSync) - consumed by Coordinator
   179→    pub sync_event_tx: Option<mpsc::Sender<SyncEvent>>,
   180→
   181→    /// Unified page update channel - all events flow through here
   182→    /// **Consumers**: UI/Lua callbacks, Broadcast to peers, Derivation engine
   183→    /// **Design**: Single channel for layer changes, ephemeral data, peer presence
   184→    /// **Arc<RwLock>**: Shared with observer tasks so new subscribers are visible
   185→    pub page_update_subscribers: Arc<RwLock<Vec<mpsc::Sender<PageUpdate>>>>,
   186→
   187→    /// Pending update source for observer context
   188→    /// **Context**: Set before import() so observer knows who caused the change
   189→    /// **Usage**: Observer reads this to populate `from_peer` in PageEvent
   190→    /// **Cleared**: After import() completes
   191→    pub pending_update_source: Arc<Mutex<Option<(String, String)>>>,
   192→
   193→    // Note: ephemeral events now go through page_update_subscribers (PageUpdate::Ephemeral)
   194→    // outbound ephemeral goes directly via SubscriberInfo.ephemeral_tx (Scribe → PeerActor channels)
   195→
   196→    /// Validation handle (for kunki node mode validation)
   197→    /// If provided, Scribe delegates validation to external ValidationService
   198→    /// This enables validation.lua to access presence_lib from LuaRuntime
   199→    /// Falls back to local validation if not available (though we're removing ScribeLuaRuntime)
   200→    pub validation_handle: Option<crate::validation_handle::ValidationHandle>,
   201→
   202→    /// Parsed permit - provides should_sync_layer, can_write_layer etc.
   203→    /// Uses gurkha::Permit directly with page_id/did passed to methods
   204→    pub our_permit: Option<gurkha::Permit>,
   205→    /// Our DID (for pattern expansion with {aud})
   206→    pub our_did: String,
   207→
   208→    /// Shutdown sender for node script tick loop (if running)
   209→    /// **Context**: Set when is_node=true and entry_node found in manifest
   210→    /// **Usage**: Send () to shutdown the tick loop
   211→    pub node_script_shutdown: Option<mpsc::Sender<()>>,
   212→}
   213→
   214→/// Arguments for spawning Scribe
   215→pub struct ScribeArgs {
   216→    pub page_id: String,
   217→    pub layers: HashMap<String, Layer>,
   218→
   219→    /// Layer persistence (saves layer snapshots)
   220→    pub layer_storage: LayerStorageRef,
   221→    /// Peer vector persistence (saves/loads peer state vectors)
   222→    pub vector_storage: PeerVectorStorageRef,
   223→    /// Peer resolver (node mode only) - lists authorized users, loads permits
   224→    pub peer_resolver: Option<PeerResolverRef>,
   225→    /// Permit issuer (node mode only) - issues layer permits for dynamic layers
   226→    pub permit_issuer: Option<PermitIssuerRef>,
   227→
   228→    /// Optional: Sync configuration derived from permit (relationship + sync_target)
   229→    /// - Owner: sync to sovereign node
   230→    /// - Node: broadcast only (no outbound sync)
   231→    /// - Viewer: sync to source node
   232→    pub sync_config: Option<SyncConfig>,
   233→    /// Channel to emit sync events (EnsureSync) - consumed by Coordinator
   234→    pub sync_event_tx: Option<mpsc::Sender<SyncEvent>>,
   235→    /// Validation handle (for kunki node mode validation)
   236→    /// If provided, Scribe delegates validation to external ValidationService
   237→    pub validation_handle: Option<crate::validation_handle::ValidationHandle>,
   238→    /// Our permit for this page (local write authorization)
   239→    /// Used to check if we can write to a layer before committing
   240→    pub our_permit: Option<String>,
   241→    /// Our DID (for pattern expansion and validation)
   242→    pub our_did: String,
   243→    /// Our username (for node script permit bindings)
   244→    pub our_username: String,
   245→    /// Whether this Scribe runs on a node (enables derivation engine and node scripts)
   246→    pub is_node: bool,
   247→    // Note: ephemeral_broadcast_tx removed - outbound ephemeral now goes directly via
   248→    // SubscriberInfo.ephemeral_tx (Scribe → PeerActor channels)
   249→}
   250→
   251→impl ScribeState {
   252→    /// Check if a layer should sync based on permit configuration
   253→    ///
   254→    /// **Context**: Used to filter out local-only layers (sync: false) before broadcasting
   255→    /// **Returns**: true if layer should sync, false if local-only
   256→    pub fn should_sync_layer(&self, layer_name: &str) -> bool {
   257→        self.our_permit
   258→            .as_ref()
   259→            .map(|permit| permit.should_sync_layer(layer_name, &self.page_id, &self.our_did))
   260→            .unwrap_or(true)  // No permit means sync everything
   261→    }
   262→
   263→    /// Check if we can write to a layer
   264→    pub fn can_write_layer(&self, layer_name: &str) -> bool {
   265→        self.our_permit
   266→            .as_ref()
   267→            .map(|permit| permit.can_write_layer(layer_name, &self.page_id, &self.our_did))
   268→            .unwrap_or(true)  // No permit means full access
   269→    }
   270→}

     2→
     3→use crate::{Butler, Result};
     4→
     5→/// Permits API facade
     6→///
     7→/// Access via `butler.permits()`

    10→}

    13→
    14→    /// Issue a one-time permit for node connection
    15→    pub async fn issue_one_time(&self, role: &str) -> Result<(String, String)> {
    16→        self.butler.issue_one_time_permit(role).await
    17→    }
    18→

    28→
    29→    /// Store a user's page permit (Node mode - for sync authorization)
    30→    ///

    32→    pub fn store_page_permit(&self, page_id: &str, user_did: &str, permit: &str) -> Result<()> {

   102→    pub async fn reissue_all_page_permits(

   114→                old_token,
   115→                user_did,
   116→                new_layers.clone(),

   126→                        error = %e,
   127→                        "Failed to reissue page permit"
   128→                    );
   129→                }
   130→            }
   131→        }

   137→
   138→    /// Store a layer permit for a peer (additive).

   141→    pub fn store_layer_permit(

   446→            Message::GetShareableLinkRequest(m) => encode_tagged(tags::GET_LINK_REQ, m),
   447→            Message::GetShareableLinkResponse(m) => encode_tagged(tags::GET_LINK_RESP, m),
   448→            Message::SpaceRequest(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SPACE_REQUEST, m),
   449→            Message::SpaceData(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SPACE_DATA, m),
   450→            Message::SpaceDataAck(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SPACE_DATA_ACK, m),
   451→            Message::SpaceRequestError(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SPACE_REQUEST_ERROR, m),
   452→            Message::SyncConsentGrant(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SYNC_CONSENT_GRANT, m),
   453→            Message::SyncConsentAck(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SYNC_CONSENT_ACK, m),
   454→            Message::LayerPermit(m) => encode_tagged(tags::LAYER_PERMIT, m),
   455→            Message::LayerConsentGrant(m) => encode_tagged(tags::LAYER_CONSENT_GRANT, m),
   456→            Message::LayerConsentAck(m) => encode_tagged(tags::LAYER_CONSENT_ACK, m),
   457→            Message::Error(m) => encode_tagged(tags::ERROR, m),
   458→        }
   459→    }
   460→
   461→    /// Deserialize message from tagged wire format
   462→    pub fn from_bytes(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, bincode::Error> {
   463→        let (tag, payload) = decode_tag(data)?;
   464→        dispatch_message(tag, payload)
   465→    }
   466→}
   467→
   468→/// Encode a message with its tag: [u16 big-endian tag][bincode payload]
   469→fn encode_tagged<T: Serialize>(tag: u16, msg: &T) -> Result<Vec<u8>, bincode::Error> {
   470→    let payload = bincode::serialize(msg)?;
   471→    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(2 + payload.len());
   472→    buf.extend_from_slice(&tag.to_be_bytes());
   473→    buf.extend_from_slice(&payload);
   474→    Ok(buf)
   475→}
   476→
   477→/// Decode tag from wire data, returning (tag, payload_slice)
   478→fn decode_tag(data: &[u8]) -> Result<(u16, &[u8]), bincode::Error> {
   479→    if data.len() < 2 {
   480→        return Err(bincode::Error::from(bincode::ErrorKind::SizeLimit));
   481→    }
   482→    let tag = u16::from_be_bytes([data[0], data[1]]);
   483→    Ok((tag, &data[2..]))
   484→}
   485→
   486→/// Dispatch tagged payload to the correct Message variant
   487→fn dispatch_message(tag: u16, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<Message, bincode::Error> {
   488→    match tag {
   489→        tags::HELLO => Ok(Message::Hello(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   490→        tags::WELCOME => Ok(Message::Welcome(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   491→        tags::PERMIT_GRANT => Ok(Message::PermitGrant(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   492→        tags::ACK => { let _: () = bincode::deserialize(payload)?; Ok(Message::Ack) }
   493→        tags::REJECTED => Ok(Message::Rejected(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   494→        tags::SYNC_OFFER => Ok(Message::SyncOffer(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   495→        tags::SYNC_ACCEPT => Ok(Message::SyncAccept(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   496→        tags::SYNC_ACK => Ok(Message::SyncAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   497→        tags::SYNC_RESET => Ok(Message::SyncReset(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   498→        tags::SYNC_SNAPSHOT => Ok(Message::SyncSnapshot(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   499→        tags::ASSET_PREPARE => Ok(Message::AssetPrepare(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   500→        tags::ASSET_READY => Ok(Message::AssetReady(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   501→        tags::ASSET_ACK => Ok(Message::AssetAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   502→        tags::PUBLISH_SPACE => Ok(Message::PublishSpace(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   503→        tags::PUBLISH_SPACE_ACK => Ok(Message::PublishSpaceAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   504→        tags::PAGE_ANNOUNCE => Ok(Message::PageAnnounce(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   505→        tags::PAGE_ANNOUNCE_ACK => Ok(Message::PageAnnounceAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   506→        tags::PERMIT_UPDATE => Ok(Message::PermitUpdate(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   507→        tags::PUBLISH_ERROR => Ok(Message::PublishError(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   508→        tags::GET_LINK_REQ => Ok(Message::GetShareableLinkRequest(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   509→        tags::GET_LINK_RESP => Ok(Message::GetShareableLinkResponse(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   510→        tags::SPACE_REQUEST => Ok(Message::SpaceRequest(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   511→        tags::SPACE_DATA => Ok(Message::SpaceData(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   512→        tags::SPACE_DATA_ACK => Ok(Message::SpaceDataAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   513→        tags::SPACE_REQUEST_ERROR => Ok(Message::SpaceRequestError(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   514→        tags::SYNC_CONSENT_GRANT => Ok(Message::SyncConsentGrant(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   515→        tags::SYNC_CONSENT_ACK => Ok(Message::SyncConsentAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   516→        tags::LAYER_PERMIT => Ok(Message::LayerPermit(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   517→        tags::LAYER_CONSENT_GRANT => Ok(Message::LayerConsentGrant(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   518→        tags::LAYER_CONSENT_ACK => Ok(Message::LayerConsentAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   519→        tags::ERROR => Ok(Message::Error(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   520→        _ => Err(bincode::Error::from(bincode::ErrorKind::Custom(
   521→            format!("Unknown message tag: 0x{:04X}", tag),
   522→        ))),
   523→    }
   524→}

   569→pub struct ConnectionString {

   571→    pub node_encryption_key: [u8; 32],
   572→    pub device_public_key: [u8; 32],
   573→    pub permit: String,
   574→}
   575→
   576→impl ConnectionString {
   577→    pub fn new(
   578→        node_public_key: [u8; 32],
   579→        node_encryption_key: [u8; 32],
   580→        device_public_key: [u8; 32],
   581→        permit: String,
   582→    ) -> Self {
   583→        Self {
   584→            node_public_key,
   585→            node_encryption_key,
   586→            device_public_key,
   587→            permit,
   588→        }
   589→    }
   590→
   591→    pub fn encode(&self) -> Result<String, serde_json::Error> {
   592→        let json = serde_json::to_string(self)?;
   593→        Ok(base64::Engine::encode(
   594→            &base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD,
   595→            json.as_bytes(),
   596→        ))
   597→    }
   598→
   599→    pub fn decode(encoded: &str) -> Result<Self, Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>> {
   600→        let bytes = base64::Engine::decode(
   601→            &base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD,
   602→            encoded,
   603→        )?;
   604→        let json = String::from_utf8(bytes)?;
   605→        let conn: Self = serde_json::from_str(&json)?;
   606→        Ok(conn)
   607→    }
   608→}

1→//! PeerActor - One actor per P2P connection
     2→//!
     3→//! Handles:
     4→//! - Handshake state machine (Hello/Welcome/PermitGrant/Ack)
     5→//! - Protocol message routing
     6→//! - Per-peer state tracking
     7→//!
     8→//! # Handshake Flow (First Connection)
     9→//!
    10→//! ```text
    11→//! Owner (User mode)                    Node (Node mode)
    12→//!     │                                      │
    13→//!     │──── Hello (first_connection) ───────>│
    14→//!     │                                      │ validate permit
    15→//!     │                                      │ store OwnerInfo
    16→//!     │                                      │ issue permit_for_owner
    17→//!     │<──────────── Welcome ────────────────│
    18→//!     │ validate permit                      │
    19→//!     │ store permit                         │
    20→//!     │ issue permit_for_node                │
    21→//!     │──────────── PermitGrant ────────────>│
    22→//!     │                                      │ store permit
    23→//!     │<──────────── Ack ────────────────────│
    24→//!     │                                      │
    25→//!   [Authenticated]                    [Authenticated]
    26→//! ```

   161→    /// **Design**: Receiver-initiates pattern ensures no lost messages
   162→    ScribeConnect {

Perfect! Now I have a comprehensive understanding of the system. Let me compile my findings into a detailed report.

## Dynamic Layer Permit System - Comprehensive Analysis

I've completed a thorough review of the dynamic layer permit system across all key components. Here's the current state:

---

### **1. LAYER PERMIT ISSUANCE (gurkha::issue_layer_permit)**

**Location**: `/home/abe/osvauld/gurkha/src/service.rs:522-568`

The `issue_layer_permit` function creates single-layer permits for dynamic layers:
- **Input**: signing key, existing permit (node's page permit), audience DID, page ID, layer name, layer config
- **Output**: (token_string, cid)
- **Facts Structure**: Minimal - token_type, page_id, relationship="layer_permit", single layers entry
- **Proof Chain**: References node's page permit for delegation chain
- **Current behavior**: Straightforward - creates permit for one specific layer

**Key observation**: This is the fundamental permit creation mechanism. It doesn't handle multiple recipients or named collaborators.

---

### **2. LAYER PERMITS STORAGE (SubscriberInfo & Butler API)**

**Location**: `/home/abe/osvauld/scribe/src/state.rs:75-139`

**Storage Structure** in `SubscriberInfo`:
```rust
pub permit: gurkha::Permit,           // Static page permit
pub layer_permits: Vec<gurkha::Permit>,  // Dynamic layer permits (additive)
```

**Butler Storage API** (`/home/abe/osvauld/butler/src/api/permits.rs:136-180`):
- `store_layer_permit(page_id, user_did, layer_name, permit_token)` - Store one permit
- `get_layer_permits(page_id, user_did)` - Retrieve Vec<(layer_name, permit_token)>
- `remove_layer_permit(page_id, user_did, layer_name)` - Delete specific permit
- `has_layer_permit(page_id, user_did, layer_name)` - Check existence

**Access Methods** in `SubscriberInfo`:
- `add_layer_permit(permit)` - Append to layer_permits vector (additive)
- `can_receive_layer()` - Uses `gurkha::can_access_with_layer_permits()` for two-tier check
- `can_write_layer()` - Same two-tier check

**Current state**: Working well. Additive model allows multiple permits per peer.

---

### **3. TWO-TIER ACCESS CHECK (can_access_with_layer_permits)**

**Location**: `/home/abe/osvauld/gurkha/src/decision/layer.rs:46-78`

**Logic**:
```
1. Check page permit layers first
2. Check each layer permit in the set
3. Fallback: creator schema matching (for DID-namespaced paths)
   - Creator can access own DID's layers without explicit permit
   - Pattern: {schema}/{creator_did}/{id}
```

**Three layers of authorization**:
1. **Page permit** (static layers, role-based access)
2. **Layer permits** (dynamic layers, specific permissions)
3. **Schema fallback** (creator ownership via namespace)

**Current state**: Fully functional. Two-tier model works correctly for mixed static/dynamic scenarios.

---

### **4. DYNAMIC LAYER DETECTION & PERMIT PREPARATION**

**Location**: `/home/abe/osvauld/scribe/src/layer_unit/dynamic.rs:98-169`

**`prepare_layer_permits()` function** determines recipients based on grant type:

**Role-based grants** (`GrantType::Role`):
- Iterate through connected peers
- Match peer's relationship against `schema.role_permissions`
- Issue permit to each matching role
- Example: "collaborator" role gets permit, "viewer" doesn't

**Explicit grants** (`GrantType::Explicit`):
- Creator always gets a permit
- **TODO (line 164)**: Named participants from layer metadata (Phase 2d)
- Currently ONLY creator is issued a permit

**Connected Peers Collection** (`collect_connected_peers_with_roles()` in apply.rs:541-555):
- Reads from `state.subscribers` (subscribed peers)
- Extracts (did, role) pairs from their stored permits
- Filters duplicates (same DID, different devices)

**Current limitation**: Explicit grants can only give permits to creator. No mechanism exists yet to:
- Specify additional named collaborators
- Grant explicit access to specific DIDs
- Store or load collaborator lists

---

### **5. PERMIT DELIVERY FLOW (Coordinator → PeerActor → Wire)**

**Stage 1: Emission** (`/home/abe/osvauld/scribe/src/sync/apply.rs:436-536`)

When a new dynamic layer is detected:
1. `emit_dynamic_layer_permits()` runs in Scribe
2. Calls `prepare_layer_permits()` to get (did, token) pairs
3. **Stores permits in node's SubscriberInfo** (lines 493-517) so broadcasting works
4. Emits `SyncEvent::NewDynamicLayer { permits }`

**Stage 2: Distribution** (`/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/coordinator/mod.rs:593-644`)

Coordinator's `on_distribute_layer_permits()`:
1. For each (recipient_did, permit_token):
   - Stores in butler via `butler.permits().store_layer_permit()`
   - Finds PeerActor for recipient via `get_peer_actor_for_did()`
   - Sends `PeerMessage::SendLayerPermit`
   - If peer not connected, permit is stored for later delivery

**Stage 3: Wire Transmission** (`/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/consent.rs:431-451`)

PeerActor's `send_layer_permit()`:
1. Generates request_id (UUID)
2. Creates `LayerPermitMsg` with page_id, layer_name, permit token
3. Sends via `send_message()` (encrypted on wire)

**Wire Format** (`/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/message.rs:287-297`):
```rust
pub struct LayerPermitMsg {
    pub request_id: String,
    pub page_id: String,
    pub layer_name: String,
    pub permit: String,
}
```

---

### **6. PERMIT RECEPTION (Peer-side)**

**Location**: `/home/abe/osvauld/courier/src/peer_actor/consent.rs:476-588`

Peer's `on_layer_permit()` handler:
1. Validates authentication (requires user mode + authenticated)
2. Extracts sender's DID from state
3. Gets own DID from identity
4. **Stores in butler**: `butler.permits().store_layer_permit(page_id, our_did, layer_name, permit)`
5. **Auto-issues consent**: Calls `issue_layer_consent()` to send consent permit back

Peer's `issue_layer_consent()`:
1. Parses layer permit to get node's pubkey (issuer)
2. Calls `gurkha::issue_sync_layer_consent()` to create consent permit
3. Sends `LayerConsentGrant` back to node

Node's `on_layer_consent_grant()` (lines 596-645):
1. Parses consent permit to get viewer's DID
2. **Stores in butler**: `butler.permits().store_viewer_layer_consent(viewer_did, page_id, layer_name, consent_permit)`
3. Sends `LayerConsentAck`

**Current state**: Full bidirectional flow working. Node → Viewer permit delivery + viewer consent capture functional.

---

### **7. GAPS & MISSING INFRASTRUCTURE FOR NAMED COLLABORATORS**

#### **Gap 1: No Collaborator List Storage**

There's no database schema for storing which specific DIDs should get explicit grants. The TODO at line 164 of `dynamic.rs` indicates this was planned but not implemented:

```rust
// TODO: Named participants (from layer metadata) — Phase 2d
```

Issue at subscription time is better. Here's why:

**Storing has a gap**: If Dave joins the page *after* a channel was created, no permit was ever generated for him. There's nothing in butler to load.

**Issuing at subscription time** handles all cases:

1. **Peer was offline when channel created** → node issues permit when they subscribe
2. **Peer joined the page after channel created** → same flow, their updated permit has the collaborator list
3. **Peer reconnects** → same flow, fresh permit issued

The node already has everything needed at subscription time:
- `PermitIssuer` for signing
- `our_permit` with `dynamic_layer_schemas`
- The subscriber's permit (just parsed)
- Dynamic layer metadata in butler (`list_dynamic_layers()`)
- Layer data in `state.units`

So the flow becomes:

1. **Channel creation**: node detects new dynamic layer → stores metadata in butler (`store_dynamic_layer_meta` — already exists, unused) → issues permits to currently connected peers (existing flow)
2. **Subscription**: node enumerates existing dynamic layers for the page → for each explicit layer, checks if this subscriber should get access → issues fresh layer permit → adds to `SubscriberInfo` → `send_initial_state_to_subscriber` sends the data

No need to pre-store permits for offline peers at all. The node generates them on demand when the peer actually shows up.

    95→/// different capability and pattern sets. The protocol only sees capabilities.

    99→    pub token_type: String,
   100→    /// Explicit protocol capabilities (relay, share, accept_publish)

   102→    pub peer_capabilities: PeerCapabilities,

   104→    /// operation_name -> "allow" | "deny"
   105→    #[serde(default)]

   108→    #[serde(default)]

   114→    /// Fixed layers (non-pattern) with their capabilities
   115→    /// layer_name -> { capability: "viewer"|"collaborator", sync: bool }
   116→    #[serde(default)]
   117→    pub layers: HashMap<String, LayerConfig>,
   118→    /// Relationship label (for logging/debugging only, NOT for business logic)
   119→    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]

   227→impl DelegationTemplate {
   228→    /// Convert template to permit facts JSON
   229→    ///
   230→    /// This creates the facts structure that will be embedded in the delegated token.
   231→    /// Role-agnostic: only includes capabilities and patterns, no role-based logic.
   232→    pub fn to_facts(&self) -> serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> {
   233→        let mut facts = serde_json::Map::new();
   234→
   235→        // Add token_type
   236→        facts.insert("token_type".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(self.token_type.clone()));
   237→
   238→        // Add peer_capabilities
   239→        facts.insert("peer_capabilities".to_string(), self.peer_capabilities.to_json());
   240→
   241→        // Add operations (required for delegation chain - e.g., add_pages permission)
   242→        if !self.operations.is_empty() {
   243→            let ops_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.operations
   244→                .iter()
   245→                .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), serde_json::Value::String(v.clone())))
   246→                .collect();
   247→            facts.insert("operations".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(ops_json));
   248→        }
   249→
   250→        // Add auth_capabilities
   251→        if !self.auth_capabilities.is_empty() {
   252→            let auth_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.auth_capabilities
   253→                .iter()
   254→                .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone()))
   255→                .collect();
   256→            facts.insert("auth_capabilities".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(auth_json));
   257→        }
   258→
   259→        // Add layer_patterns
   260→        if !self.layer_patterns.is_empty() {
   261→            let patterns_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.layer_patterns
   262→                .iter()
   263→                .map(|(pattern, config)| {
   264→                    (pattern.clone(), serde_json::json!({
   265→                        "create": config.create,
   266→                        "sync": config.sync,
   267→                        "write": config.write
   268→                    }))
   269→                })
   270→                .collect();
   271→            facts.insert("layer_patterns".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(patterns_json));
   272→        }
   273→
   274→        // Add fixed layers
   275→        if !self.layers.is_empty() {
   276→            let layers_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.layers
   277→                .iter()
   278→                .map(|(name, config)| {
   279→                    let mut layer_obj = serde_json::Map::new();
   280→                    layer_obj.insert("sync".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(config.sync));
   281→                    layer_obj.insert("write".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(config.write));
   282→                    if let Some(ref t) = config.layer_type {
   283→                        layer_obj.insert("type".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(t.clone()));
   284→                    }
   285→                    (name.clone(), serde_json::Value::Object(layer_obj))
   286→                })
   287→                .collect();
   288→            facts.insert("layers".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(layers_json));
   289→        }
   290→
   291→        // Add relationship (for logging only)
   292→        if let Some(rel) = &self.relationship {
   293→            facts.insert("relationship".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(rel.clone()));
   294→        }
   295→
   296→        // Add issue_on (self-describing templates for what to issue on actions)
   297→        if !self.issue_on.is_empty() {
   298→            let issue_on_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.issue_on
   299→                .iter()
   300→                .map(|(action, template)| {
   301→                    (action.clone(), serde_json::Value::Object(template.to_facts()))
   302→                })
   303→                .collect();
   304→            facts.insert("issue_on".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(issue_on_json));
   305→        }
   306→
   307→        // Add presence configuration
   308→        if let Some(ref presence) = self.presence {
   309→            let mut presence_json = serde_json::Map::new();
   310→            presence_json.insert("visible".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(presence.visible));
   311→            presence_json.insert("can_see_others".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(presence.can_see_others));
   312→            if let Some(ref name) = presence.name {
   313→                presence_json.insert("name".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(name.clone()));
   314→            }
   315→            facts.insert("presence".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(presence_json));
   316→        }
   317→
   318→        // Add ephemeral_funcs (allowed ephemeral function names)
   319→        if !self.ephemeral_funcs.is_empty() {
   320→            let funcs: Vec<serde_json::Value> = self.ephemeral_funcs
   321→                .iter()
   322→                .map(|f| serde_json::Value::String(f.clone()))
   323→                .collect();
   324→            facts.insert("ephemeral_funcs".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Array(funcs));
   325→        }
   326→
   327→        // Add dynamic_layer_schemas
   328→        if !self.dynamic_layer_schemas.is_empty() {
   329→            let schemas_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.dynamic_layer_schemas
   330→                .iter()
   331→                .map(|(pattern, schema)| {
   332→                    (pattern.clone(), serde_json::to_value(schema).unwrap_or_default())
   333→                })
   334→                .collect();
   335→            facts.insert("dynamic_layer_schemas".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(schemas_json));
   336→        }
   337→
   338→        facts
   339→    }
   340→}

   342→/// Parsed Permit token with domain logic (role-agnostic design).
   343→///
   344→/// The protocol only sees capabilities and patterns, not role labels.
   345→/// Contains all permit data including raw token, parsed UCAN, and extracted facts.
   346→#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
   347→pub struct Permit {
   348→    // Core permit data (merged from PermitCore)
   349→    /// Raw permit token string
   350→    raw_token: String,
   351→    /// Parsed token (uses ucan library internally)
   352→    parsed: Ucan,
   353→    /// Raw facts as JSON (source of truth)
   354→    facts: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
   355→
   356→    // Extracted/parsed fields
   357→    /// Explicit protocol capabilities (relay, share, accept_publish)
   358→    peer_capabilities: PeerCapabilities,
   359→    /// Fixed layer configs (layer_name -> config)
   360→    layers: HashMap<String, LayerConfig>,
   361→    /// Layer patterns for identity-based access (pattern -> config)
   362→    /// Patterns support `{aud}`, `{page_id}` placeholders
   363→    layer_patterns: HashMap<String, LayerPatternConfig>,
   364→    /// Self-describing templates: what to issue when holder takes actions
   365→    /// Keys: "page_request", "share_link", etc.
   366→    issue_on: HashMap<String, DelegationTemplate>,
   367→    /// Parent permit CIDs for delegation chain
   368→    proof_chain: Vec<String>,
   369→    /// Sync behavior facts (local_only, no_incoming_updates, send_full_snapshot)
   370→    sync_facts: SyncFacts,
   371→    /// Presence configuration (visibility, display name)
   372→    presence: Option<PresenceConfig>,
   373→    /// Allowed ephemeral function names (empty = all allowed)
   374→    ephemeral_funcs: Vec<String>,
   375→    /// Schemas for dynamically-created layers (channels, DMs, orders)
   376→    dynamic_layer_schemas: HashMap<String, DynamicLayerSchema>,
   377→}
   378→
   379→impl Permit {
   380→    /// Parse permit token and extract all domain information.
   381→    ///
   382→    /// Role-agnostic: extracts capabilities and patterns, not role labels.
   383→    pub fn from_token(token: &str) -> PermitResult<Self> {
   384→        use tracing::trace;
   385→
   386→        trace!("Parsing permit token (len={})", token.len());
   387→
   388→        // Parse permit token (uses ucan library internally)
   389→        let parsed = Ucan::try_from(token)
   390→            .map_err(|e| PermitError::ParsingFailed(format!("Permit parsing error: {}", e)))?;
   391→
   392→        trace!("JWT decoded - issuer: {}, audience: {}", parsed.issuer(), parsed.audience());
   393→
   394→        // Extract facts as raw JSON (source of truth)
   395→        let facts_ref = parsed.facts().as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
   396→            PermitError::MissingField("Permit facts not found".to_string())
   397→        })?;
   398→
   399→        // Convert BTreeMap to serde_json::Value for deserialization
   400→        let facts_value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::to_value(facts_ref)
   401→            .map_err(|e| PermitError::ParsingFailed(format!("Facts conversion error: {}", e)))?;
   402→
   403→        // Deserialize structured facts via serde (replaces ~60 lines of manual parsing)
   404→        let parsed_facts: PermitFacts = serde_json::from_value(facts_value.clone())
   405→            .unwrap_or_default();
   406→
   407→        // Keep raw facts map for get_fact() lookups
   408→        let facts: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = facts_ref
   409→            .iter()
   410→            .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone()))
   411→            .collect();
   412→
   413→        trace!(facts = ?facts.keys().collect::<Vec<_>>(), "Facts extracted");
   414→
   415→        // Parse issue_on templates
   416→        let issue_on: HashMap<String, DelegationTemplate> = parsed_facts.issue_on
   417→            .iter()
   418→            .filter_map(|(key, val)| {
   419→                Self::parse_delegation_template(key, val).map(|t| (key.clone(), t))
   420→            })
   421→            .collect();
   422→
   423→        // Extract proof chain
   424→        let proof_chain = parsed.proofs().clone().unwrap_or_default();
   425→
   426→        Ok(Self {
   427→            raw_token: token.to_string(),
   428→            parsed,
   429→            facts,
   430→            peer_capabilities: parsed_facts.peer_capabilities,
   431→            layers: parsed_facts.layers,
   432→            layer_patterns: parsed_facts.layer_patterns,
   433→            issue_on,
   434→            proof_chain,
   435→            sync_facts: parsed_facts.sync,
   436→            presence: parsed_facts.presence,
   437→            ephemeral_funcs: parsed_facts.ephemeral_funcs,
   438→            dynamic_layer_schemas: parsed_facts.dynamic_layer_schemas,
   439→        })
   440→    }
   441→
   442→    /// Parse a DelegationTemplate from a JSON value
   443→    fn parse_delegation_template(key: &str, template_val: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<DelegationTemplate> {
   444→        let template_obj = template_val.as_object()?;
   445→
   446→        // Extract token_type
   447→        let token_type = template_obj
   448→            .get("token_type")
   449→            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
   450→            .map(String::from)
   451→            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("delegated_{}", key));
   452→
   453→        // Extract peer_capabilities
   454→        let peer_capabilities = template_obj
   455→            .get("peer_capabilities")
   456→            .and_then(|v| v.as_object())
   457→            .map(PeerCapabilities::from_json)
   458→            .unwrap_or_default();
   459→
   460→        // Extract layer_patterns
   461→        let mut layer_patterns = HashMap::new();
   462→        if let Some(patterns_obj) = template_obj.get("layer_patterns").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   463→            for (pattern, config) in patterns_obj {
   464→                if let Some(config_obj) = config.as_object() {
   465→                    layer_patterns.insert(
   466→                        pattern.clone(),
   467→                        LayerPatternConfig {
   468→                            create: config_obj.get("create").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   469→                            sync: config_obj.get("sync").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   470→                            write: config_obj.get("write").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   471→                        },
   472→                    );
   473→                }
   474→            }
   475→        }
   476→
   477→        // Extract fixed layers
   478→        let mut layers = HashMap::new();
   479→        if let Some(layers_obj) = template_obj.get("layers").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   480→            for (layer_name, layer_val) in layers_obj {
   481→                if let Some(layer_obj) = layer_val.as_object() {
   482→                    layers.insert(layer_name.clone(), LayerConfig {
   483→                        sync: layer_obj.get("sync").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   484→                        write: layer_obj.get("write").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   485→                        layer_type: layer_obj.get("type").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).map(String::from),
   486→                    });
   487→                }
   488→            }
   489→        }
   490→
   491→        // Extract relationship (for logging only)
   492→        let relationship = template_obj
   493→            .get("relationship")
   494→            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
   495→            .map(String::from);
   496→
   497→        // Extract operations (e.g., add_pages, share_page)
   498→        let mut operations = HashMap::new();
   499→        if let Some(ops_obj) = template_obj.get("operations").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   500→            for (op_name, op_val) in ops_obj {
   501→                if let Some(op_str) = op_val.as_str() {
   502→                    operations.insert(op_name.clone(), op_str.to_string());
   503→                }
   504→            }
   505→        }
   506→
   507→        // Extract auth_capabilities (can_connect, sync_enabled, etc.)
   508→        let mut auth_capabilities = HashMap::new();
   509→        if let Some(auth_obj) = template_obj.get("auth_capabilities").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   510→            for (cap_name, cap_val) in auth_obj {
   511→                auth_capabilities.insert(cap_name.clone(), cap_val.clone());
   512→            }
   513→        }
   514→
   515→        // Extract issue_on (recursive - templates for what to issue on actions)
   516→        let mut issue_on = HashMap::new();
   517→        if let Some(issue_on_obj) = template_obj.get("issue_on").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   518→            for (action_key, nested_template_val) in issue_on_obj {
   519→                if let Some(nested_template) = Self::parse_delegation_template(action_key, nested_template_val) {
   520→                    issue_on.insert(action_key.clone(), Box::new(nested_template));
   521→                }
   522→            }
   523→        }
   524→
   525→        // Extract presence configuration
   526→        let presence = template_obj.get("presence").and_then(|v| v.as_object()).map(|p| {
   527→            PresenceConfig {
   528→                visible: p.get("visible").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   529→                can_see_others: p.get("can_see_others").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(true),
   530→                name: p.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).map(String::from),
   531→            }
   532→        });
   533→
   534→        // Extract ephemeral_funcs
   535→        let ephemeral_funcs = template_obj.get("ephemeral_funcs")
   536→            .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
   537→            .map(|arr| {
   538→                arr.iter()
   539→                    .filter_map(|v| v.as_str().map(String::from))
   540→                    .collect()
   541→            })
   542→            .unwrap_or_default();
   543→
   544→        // Extract dynamic_layer_schemas
   545→        let mut dynamic_layer_schemas = HashMap::new();
   546→        if let Some(schemas_obj) = template_obj.get("dynamic_layer_schemas").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   547→            for (pattern, schema_val) in schemas_obj {
   548→                if let Ok(schema) = serde_json::from_value::<DynamicLayerSchema>(schema_val.clone()) {
   549→                    dynamic_layer_schemas.insert(pattern.clone(), schema);
   550→                }
   551→            }
   552→        }
   553→
   554→        Some(DelegationTemplate {
   555→            token_type,
   556→            peer_capabilities,
   557→            operations,
   558→            auth_capabilities,
   559→            layer_patterns,
   560→            layers,
   561→            relationship,
   562→            issue_on,
   563→            presence,
   564→            ephemeral_funcs,
   565→            dynamic_layer_schemas,
   566→        })
   567→    }
   568→
   569→    /// Get the raw token string
   570→    pub fn raw_token(&self) -> &str {
   571→        &self.raw_token

   573→

   580→        &self.proof_chain

   903→fn strip_page_prefix(expanded: &str, page_id: &str) -> String {

   927→pub fn resolve_page_id_in_facts(facts: &mut serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>, page_id: &str) {

   929→    if let Some(layers) = facts.remove("layers") {

   953→                }
   954→            }
   955→            facts.insert("issue_on".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(resolved_issue_on));

   967→/// **Examples:**

   969→/// - `dms/uuid-123/messages` matches `dms/{id}/messages`
   970→/// - `orders/uuid-456` matches `orders/{id}`
   971→pub fn matches_schema_pattern(layer_path: &str, schema_pattern: &str) -> bool {

  1010→pub fn matches_wildcard(layer_name: &str, pattern: &str) -> bool {

1→//! Connection Token Decisions
     2→//!
     3→//! Decision functions for connection-related tokens:
     4→//! - One-time connection tokens
     5→//! - Peer connection tokens
     6→//! - Viewer authentication tokens
     7→//!
     8→//! **Architecture**: Template-driven, not role-based.
     9→//! - Templates define capability sets (keyed by human-readable names like "node_owner")
    10→//! - Template lookup extracts capabilities into permit
    11→//! - Protocol code checks actual capabilities in permit, never the template key
    12→//!
    13→//! Note: `peer_capabilities` are for protocol-level decisions (capability-based, not role-based).
    14→
    15→use super::types::{DecisionResult, TokenDecision};
    16→use crate::errors::GurkhaError;
    17→use base64::{engine::general_purpose, Engine as _};
    18→use ed25519_dalek::VerifyingKey;
    19→use serde_json::json;
    20→use std::sync::LazyLock;
    21→
    22→/// Embedded connection templates (loaded at compile time)
    23→static CONNECTION_TEMPLATES: LazyLock<serde_json::Value> = LazyLock::new(|| {
    24→    serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../../templates/connection.json"))
    25→        .expect("Invalid connection.json template")
    26→});
    27→
    28→/// Load connection template by key
    29→///
    30→/// Template keys ("node_owner", "viewer_node", etc.) are just lookup keys.
    31→/// The protocol never checks these keys - it checks the capabilities inside.
    32→fn load_connection_template(key: &str) -> Result<&'static serde_json::Value, GurkhaError> {
    33→    CONNECTION_TEMPLATES
    34→        .get(key)
    35→        .ok_or_else(|| GurkhaError::ValidationError(format!("Unknown connection template: {}", key)))
    36→}
    37→
    38→/// Build TokenDecision from a connection template
    39→///
    40→/// **Context**: Extracts capabilities from template into permit facts.
    41→/// No role matching happens here - just capability extraction.
    42→fn build_decision_from_template(
    43→    decision: &mut TokenDecision,
    44→    template: &serde_json::Value,
    45→    relationship: &str,
    46→) {
    47→    // Add relationship label (for logging/debugging only)
    48→    decision.add_fact("relationship".into(), json!(relationship));
    49→
    50→    // Extract peer_capabilities
    51→    if let Some(peer_caps) = template.get("peer_capabilities") {
    52→        decision.add_fact("peer_capabilities".into(), peer_caps.clone());
    53→    }
    54→
    55→    // Extract auth_capabilities
    56→    if let Some(auth_caps) = template.get("auth_capabilities") {
    57→        decision.add_fact("auth_capabilities".into(), auth_caps.clone());
    58→    }
    59→
    60→    // Extract operations
    61→    if let Some(ops) = template.get("operations") {
    62→        decision.add_fact("operations".into(), ops.clone());
    63→    }
    64→
    65→    // Extract presence config
    66→    if let Some(presence) = template.get("presence") {
    67→        decision.add_fact("presence".into(), presence.clone());
    68→    }
    69→}
    70→
    71→/// Decide what should be in a one-time connection token
    72→///
    73→/// One-time tokens have:
    74→/// - Wildcard audience (for first connection)
    75→/// - Facts-based authorization (no URI capabilities)
    76→/// - Template-driven capabilities
    77→/// - 30 day expiry
    78→pub fn decide_one_time_token(
    79→    verifying_key: &VerifyingKey,
    80→    relationship: &str,
    81→) -> DecisionResult<TokenDecision> {
    82→    let pub_key_b64 = general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(verifying_key.as_bytes());
    83→
    84→    // Load template (validates relationship is known)
    85→    let template = load_connection_template(relationship)?;
    86→
    87→    let mut decision = TokenDecision::new("*"); // Wildcard audience
    88→
    89→    // Core facts
    90→    decision.add_fact("token_type".into(), json!("one_time_connection"));
    91→    decision.add_fact("first_connection".into(), json!(true));
    92→    decision.add_fact("user_id".into(), json!(pub_key_b64));
    93→
    94→    // Extract capabilities from template
    95→    build_decision_from_template(&mut decision, template, relationship);
    96→
    97→    decision.set_expiry(30 * 24 * 60 * 60); // 30 days
    98→
    99→    Ok(decision)
   100→}
   101→
   102→/// Decide what should be in a peer connection token
   103→///
   104→/// Peer tokens have:
   105→/// - Specific peer's pubkey as audience
   106→/// - Facts-based authorization (no URI capabilities)
   107→/// - Template-driven capabilities
   108→/// - No expiry (persistent connection)
   109→pub fn decide_peer_connection(
   110→    verifying_key: &VerifyingKey,
   111→    peer_pubkey: &str,
   112→    relationship: &str,
   113→) -> DecisionResult<TokenDecision> {
   114→    let pub_key_b64 = general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(verifying_key.as_bytes());
   115→
   116→    // Load template (validates relationship is known)
   117→    let template = load_connection_template(relationship)?;
   118→
   119→    let mut decision = TokenDecision::new(peer_pubkey);
   120→
   121→    // Core facts
   122→    decision.add_fact(
   123→        "token_type".into(),
   124→        json!(format!("{}_connection", relationship)),
   125→    );
   126→    decision.add_fact("user_id".into(), json!(pub_key_b64));
   127→
   128→    // Extract capabilities from template
   129→    build_decision_from_template(&mut decision, template, relationship);
   130→
   131→    Ok(decision)
   132→}
   133→
   134→/// Decide what should be in a page viewer authentication token
   135→pub fn decide_page_viewer_auth(
   136→    verifying_key: &VerifyingKey,
   137→    page_id: &str,
   138→) -> DecisionResult<TokenDecision> {
   139→    let pub_key_b64 = general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(verifying_key.as_bytes());
   140→
   141→    // Load viewer template
   142→    let template = load_connection_template("node_viewer")?;
   143→
   144→    let mut decision = TokenDecision::new(&pub_key_b64); // Self-signed initially
   145→
   146→    // Core facts
   147→    decision.add_fact("token_type".into(), json!("viewer_auth"));
   148→    decision.add_fact("page_id".into(), json!(page_id));
   149→    decision.add_fact("user_id".into(), json!(pub_key_b64));
   150→
   151→    // Extract capabilities from template
   152→    build_decision_from_template(&mut decision, template, "viewer");
   153→
   154→    Ok(decision)
   155→}
   156→
   157→/// Decide what should be in a space viewer authentication token
   158→///
   159→/// This is for shareable links - one-time use, wildcard audience.
   160→/// The viewer uses this token to initiate connection to the node.
   161→///
   162→/// Space viewer auth tokens have:
   163→/// - Wildcard audience (for one-time shareable link)
   164→/// - Facts-based authorization (no URI capabilities)
   165→/// - Space context and viewer relationship
   166→/// - 30 day expiry
   167→pub fn decide_space_viewer_auth(
   168→    verifying_key: &VerifyingKey,
   169→    space_id: &str,
   170→) -> DecisionResult<TokenDecision> {
   171→    let pub_key_b64 = general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(verifying_key.as_bytes());
   172→
   173→    // Load viewer template
   174→    let template = load_connection_template("node_viewer")?;
   175→
   176→    let mut decision = TokenDecision::new("*"); // Wildcard audience for shareable link
   177→
   178→    // Core facts
   179→    decision.add_fact("token_type".into(), json!("viewer_auth"));
   180→    decision.add_fact("first_connection".into(), json!(false)); // Viewers never do first_connection
   181→    decision.add_fact("space_id".into(), json!(space_id));
   182→    decision.add_fact("user_id".into(), json!(pub_key_b64));
   183→
   184→    // Extract capabilities from template
   185→    build_decision_from_template(&mut decision, template, "node_viewer");
   186→
   187→    // Add space_access operation
   188→    decision.add_fact(
   189→        "operations".into(),
   190→        json!({
   191→            "own": "deny",
   192→            "read": "allow",
   193→            "write": "deny",
   194→            "space_access": "allow"
   195→        }),
   196→    );
   197→
   198→    // Short expiry for security (30 days like one-time connection)
   199→    decision.set_expiry(30 * 24 * 60 * 60);
   200→
   201→    Ok(decision)
   202→}
   203→

1→//! Scribe message types
     2→//!
     3→//! Contains both the actor messages (ScribeMessage) and shared types
     4→//! (BroadcastPayload, PageUpdate, etc.)
     5→
     6→use std::collections::HashMap;
     7→use std::path::PathBuf;
     8→
     9→use ractor::RpcReplyPort;
    10→use tokio::sync::mpsc;
    11→use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
    12→
    13→use domains::{QuerySpec, QueryDelta, QueryResult, JsonOp};
    14→use crate::Result;
    15→
    16→/// Payload sent to PeerActor for broadcast (3-step sync protocol)
    17→///
    18→/// **Context**: Scribe sends this to PeerActor, who then sends SyncOffer to peer
    19→/// **state_vector**: Our state vector after this update (for 3-step protocol)
    20→/// **layer_type**: Protocol routing hint (App=snapshot, Data=incremental, Static=blob)
    21→#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    22→pub struct BroadcastPayload {
    23→    pub page_id: String,
    24→    pub layer_name: String,
    25→    pub update: Vec<u8>,
    26→    /// Our state vector for this layer (for SyncOffer message)
    27→    pub state_vector: Vec<u8>,
    28→    /// Layer type for protocol routing
    29→    pub layer_type: domains::LayerType,
    30→}
    31→
    32→/// Ephemeral broadcast payload (generic)
    33→///
    34→/// **Context**: Scribe sends this to Butler/Courier for datagram broadcast
    35→/// **Transport**: Unreliable QUIC datagram (fire-and-forget, lowest latency)
    36→/// **Design**: Generic payload - app defines format; protocol routes by page_id
    37→#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
    38→pub struct EphemeralBroadcast {
    39→    /// Page ID for routing
    40→    pub page_id: String,
    41→    /// Opaque payload - app defines format (JSON with type/x/y, etc.)
    42→    pub payload: Vec<u8>,
    43→}
    44→
    45→/// Outbound ephemeral data (Scribe → PeerActor via channel)
    46→///
    47→/// **Context**: Same pattern as BroadcastPayload for CRDT data
    48→/// **Flow**: Scribe broadcasts ephemeral to all subscriber channels,
    49→///           PeerActor listener receives and sends datagram to peer
    50→#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    51→pub struct EphemeralOutbound {
    52→    /// Page ID for routing (used in datagram)
    53→    pub page_id: String,
    54→    /// Opaque payload - app defines format (JSON with type/x/y, etc.)
    55→    pub payload: Vec<u8>,
    56→}
    57→
    58→/// Delta operations for different Loro container types
    59→///
    60→/// **Context**: Represents incremental changes to CRDT containers
    61→/// **Usage**: Lua apps can apply deltas for efficient UI updates (preserve scroll, animations)
    62→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    63→#[serde(tag = "type")]
    64→pub enum LoroDelta {
    65→    /// List delta: sequence of Retain/Insert/Delete operations
    66→    List { ops: Vec<ListOp> },
    67→
    68→    /// Map delta: updated keys
    69→    Map { updated: HashMap<String, Option<serde_json::Value>> },
    70→
    71→    /// Text delta (for future rich text support)
    72→    Text { ops: Vec<TextOp> },
    73→}
    74→
    75→/// List delta operations (applied sequentially)
    76→///
    77→/// **Context**: Represents changes to a Loro list container
    78→/// **Example**: [Retain(3), Insert([msg4]), Delete(1)] means "skip 3 items, insert msg4, delete 1 item"
    79→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    80→#[serde(tag = "op")]
    81→pub enum ListOp {
    82→    /// Keep N items unchanged (advance cursor)
    83→    Retain { count: usize },
    84→
    85→    /// Insert values at current position
    86→    Insert { values: Vec<serde_json::Value> },
    87→
    88→    /// Delete N items at current position
    89→    Delete { count: usize },
    90→}
    91→
    92→/// Text delta operations (for rich text editing)
    93→///
    94→/// **Context**: Represents changes to a Loro text container
    95→/// **Note**: Deferred for now - will implement when we need rich text editing
    96→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    97→#[serde(tag = "op")]
    98→pub enum TextOp {
    99→    /// Keep N characters unchanged
   100→    Retain { count: usize },
   101→
   102→    /// Insert text at current position
   103→    Insert { text: String },
   104→
   105→    /// Delete N characters at current position
   106→    Delete { count: usize },
   107→}
   108→
   109→// Unified Page Update Channel (Replaces PageEvent + EphemeralEvent + QueryDelta)
   110→
   111→/// Unified update enum for all page events
   112→///
   113→/// **Context**: Single channel replaces 3 separate broadcast types
   114→/// **Benefits**: 3 listener tasks → 1, unified fan-out logic
   115→/// **Consumers**: UI/Lua callbacks, Broadcast to peers, Derivation engine
   116→#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
   117→pub enum PageUpdate {
   118→    /// Layer data changed (local edit or remote sync)
   119→    LayerChanged {
   120→        layer: String,
   121→        from_peer: Option<(String, String)>,  // (did, device_id)
   122→        /// Structured operations extracted from the update (same format as validation)
   123→        /// Enables surgical UI updates - Lua can process individual ops
   124→        ops: Option<Vec<JsonOp>>,
   125→        delta: Option<LoroDelta>,
   126→        state_vector: Vec<u8>,
   127→        /// Full layer state as JSON — None when delta is available (avoids O(N) serialization)
   128→        /// Some for initial load, wildcard bindings, or fallback scenarios
   129→        full_data: Option<serde_json::Value>,
   130→        /// True if this is a newly created layer (first time seeing it)
   131→        created: bool,
   132→    },
   133→
   134→    /// Ephemeral data from remote peer (cursor, typing, etc.)
   135→    Ephemeral {
   136→        user_did: String,
   137→        device_id: String,
   138→        payload: Vec<u8>,

    11→//! Services are stateless functions - Butler injects store/identity into them.
    12→//!

    14→//! Butler uses sub-object APIs for grouped operations:
    15→//! - `butler.spaces()` - Space CRUD and publishing
    16→//! - `butler.pages()` - Page CRUD and lifecycle
    17→//! - `butler.apps()` - App layer operations
    18→//! - `butler.files()` - File storage operations
    19→//! - `butler.publish()` - Publish operations
    20→//! - `butler.assets()` - Asset upload
    21→//! - `butler.nodes()` - Node and owner operations
    22→//! - `butler.contacts()` - Contact operations

1→//! Protocol message types for P2P communication
     2→//!
     3→//! All messages exchanged between peers are defined here.
     4→//! courier owns serialization/deserialization.
     5→//!
     6→//! ## Wire Format
     7→//!
     8→//! Each message is encoded as: `[u16 tag (big-endian)][bincode payload]`
     9→//! The outer transport wraps in `[u32 len][payload]`.
    10→//!
    11→//! Tags are grouped by category:
    12→//! - 0x00xx: Handshake
    13→//! - 0x01xx: Sync
    14→//! - 0x02xx: Publishing
    15→//! - 0x03xx: Viewer
    16→//! - 0x04xx: Assets
    17→//! - 0x05xx: Consent
    18→//! - 0xFFxx: Errors
    19→
    20→use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

    24→

   414→            Message::SpaceRequestError(_) => "SpaceRequestError",

   423→
   424→    /// Serialize message to tagged wire format: [u16 tag][bincode payload]
   425→    pub fn to_bytes(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, bincode::Error> {
   426→        match self {
   427→            Message::Hello(m) => encode_tagged(tags::HELLO, m),
   428→            Message::Welcome(m) => encode_tagged(tags::WELCOME, m),
   429→            Message::PermitGrant(m) => encode_tagged(tags::PERMIT_GRANT, m),
   430→            Message::Ack => encode_tagged(tags::ACK, &()),
   431→            Message::Rejected(m) => encode_tagged(tags::REJECTED, m),
   432→            Message::SyncOffer(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SYNC_OFFER, m),
   433→            Message::SyncAccept(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SYNC_ACCEPT, m),
   434→            Message::SyncAck(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SYNC_ACK, m),
   435→            Message::SyncReset(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SYNC_RESET, m),
   436→            Message::SyncSnapshot(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SYNC_SNAPSHOT, m),
   437→            Message::AssetPrepare(m) => encode_tagged(tags::ASSET_PREPARE, m),
   438→            Message::AssetReady(m) => encode_tagged(tags::ASSET_READY, m),
   439→            Message::AssetAck(m) => encode_tagged(tags::ASSET_ACK, m),
   440→            Message::PublishSpace(m) => encode_tagged(tags::PUBLISH_SPACE, m),
   441→            Message::PublishSpaceAck(m) => encode_tagged(tags::PUBLISH_SPACE_ACK, m),
   442→            Message::PageAnnounce(m) => encode_tagged(tags::PAGE_ANNOUNCE, m),
   443→            Message::PageAnnounceAck(m) => encode_tagged(tags::PAGE_ANNOUNCE_ACK, m),
   444→            Message::PermitUpdate(m) => encode_tagged(tags::PERMIT_UPDATE, m),
   445→            Message::PublishError(m) => encode_tagged(tags::PUBLISH_ERROR, m),
   446→            Message::GetShareableLinkRequest(m) => encode_tagged(tags::GET_LINK_REQ, m),
   447→            Message::GetShareableLinkResponse(m) => encode_tagged(tags::GET_LINK_RESP, m),
   448→            Message::SpaceRequest(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SPACE_REQUEST, m),
   449→            Message::SpaceData(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SPACE_DATA, m),
   450→            Message::SpaceDataAck(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SPACE_DATA_ACK, m),
   451→            Message::SpaceRequestError(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SPACE_REQUEST_ERROR, m),
   452→            Message::SyncConsentGrant(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SYNC_CONSENT_GRANT, m),
   453→            Message::SyncConsentAck(m) => encode_tagged(tags::SYNC_CONSENT_ACK, m),
   454→            Message::LayerPermit(m) => encode_tagged(tags::LAYER_PERMIT, m),
   455→            Message::LayerConsentGrant(m) => encode_tagged(tags::LAYER_CONSENT_GRANT, m),
   456→            Message::LayerConsentAck(m) => encode_tagged(tags::LAYER_CONSENT_ACK, m),
   457→            Message::Error(m) => encode_tagged(tags::ERROR, m),
   458→        }
   459→    }
   460→
   461→    /// Deserialize message from tagged wire format
   462→    pub fn from_bytes(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, bincode::Error> {
   463→        let (tag, payload) = decode_tag(data)?;
   464→        dispatch_message(tag, payload)
   465→    }
   466→}
   467→
   468→/// Encode a message with its tag: [u16 big-endian tag][bincode payload]
   469→fn encode_tagged<T: Serialize>(tag: u16, msg: &T) -> Result<Vec<u8>, bincode::Error> {
   470→    let payload = bincode::serialize(msg)?;
   471→    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(2 + payload.len());
   472→    buf.extend_from_slice(&tag.to_be_bytes());
   473→    buf.extend_from_slice(&payload);
   474→    Ok(buf)
   475→}
   476→
   477→/// Decode tag from wire data, returning (tag, payload_slice)
   478→fn decode_tag(data: &[u8]) -> Result<(u16, &[u8]), bincode::Error> {
   479→    if data.len() < 2 {
   480→        return Err(bincode::Error::from(bincode::ErrorKind::SizeLimit));
   481→    }
   482→    let tag = u16::from_be_bytes([data[0], data[1]]);
   483→    Ok((tag, &data[2..]))
   484→}
   485→
   486→/// Dispatch tagged payload to the correct Message variant
   487→fn dispatch_message(tag: u16, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<Message, bincode::Error> {
   488→    match tag {
   489→        tags::HELLO => Ok(Message::Hello(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   490→        tags::WELCOME => Ok(Message::Welcome(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   491→        tags::PERMIT_GRANT => Ok(Message::PermitGrant(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   492→        tags::ACK => { let _: () = bincode::deserialize(payload)?; Ok(Message::Ack) }
   493→        tags::REJECTED => Ok(Message::Rejected(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   494→        tags::SYNC_OFFER => Ok(Message::SyncOffer(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   495→        tags::SYNC_ACCEPT => Ok(Message::SyncAccept(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   496→        tags::SYNC_ACK => Ok(Message::SyncAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   497→        tags::SYNC_RESET => Ok(Message::SyncReset(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   498→        tags::SYNC_SNAPSHOT => Ok(Message::SyncSnapshot(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   499→        tags::ASSET_PREPARE => Ok(Message::AssetPrepare(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   500→        tags::ASSET_READY => Ok(Message::AssetReady(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   501→        tags::ASSET_ACK => Ok(Message::AssetAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   502→        tags::PUBLISH_SPACE => Ok(Message::PublishSpace(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   503→        tags::PUBLISH_SPACE_ACK => Ok(Message::PublishSpaceAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   504→        tags::PAGE_ANNOUNCE => Ok(Message::PageAnnounce(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   505→        tags::PAGE_ANNOUNCE_ACK => Ok(Message::PageAnnounceAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   506→        tags::PERMIT_UPDATE => Ok(Message::PermitUpdate(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   507→        tags::PUBLISH_ERROR => Ok(Message::PublishError(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   508→        tags::GET_LINK_REQ => Ok(Message::GetShareableLinkRequest(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   509→        tags::GET_LINK_RESP => Ok(Message::GetShareableLinkResponse(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   510→        tags::SPACE_REQUEST => Ok(Message::SpaceRequest(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   511→        tags::SPACE_DATA => Ok(Message::SpaceData(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   512→        tags::SPACE_DATA_ACK => Ok(Message::SpaceDataAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   513→        tags::SPACE_REQUEST_ERROR => Ok(Message::SpaceRequestError(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   514→        tags::SYNC_CONSENT_GRANT => Ok(Message::SyncConsentGrant(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   515→        tags::SYNC_CONSENT_ACK => Ok(Message::SyncConsentAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   516→        tags::LAYER_PERMIT => Ok(Message::LayerPermit(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   517→        tags::LAYER_CONSENT_GRANT => Ok(Message::LayerConsentGrant(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   518→        tags::LAYER_CONSENT_ACK => Ok(Message::LayerConsentAck(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   519→        tags::ERROR => Ok(Message::Error(bincode::deserialize(payload)?)),
   520→        _ => Err(bincode::Error::from(bincode::ErrorKind::Custom(
   521→            format!("Unknown message tag: 0x{:04X}", tag),
   522→        ))),
   523→    }
   524→}

   569→pub struct ConnectionString {

   571→    pub node_encryption_key: [u8; 32],
   572→    pub device_public_key: [u8; 32],
   573→    pub permit: String,
   574→}
   575→
   576→impl ConnectionString {
   577→    pub fn new(
   578→        node_public_key: [u8; 32],
   579→        node_encryption_key: [u8; 32],
   580→        device_public_key: [u8; 32],
   581→        permit: String,
   582→    ) -> Self {
   583→        Self {
   584→            node_public_key,
   585→            node_encryption_key,
   586→            device_public_key,
   587→            permit,
   588→        }
   589→    }
   590→
   591→    pub fn encode(&self) -> Result<String, serde_json::Error> {
   592→        let json = serde_json::to_string(self)?;
   593→        Ok(base64::Engine::encode(
   594→            &base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD,
   595→            json.as_bytes(),
   596→        ))
   597→    }
   598→
   599→    pub fn decode(encoded: &str) -> Result<Self, Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>> {
   600→        let bytes = base64::Engine::decode(
   601→            &base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD,
   602→            encoded,
   603→        )?;
   604→        let json = String::from_utf8(bytes)?;
   605→        let conn: Self = serde_json::from_str(&json)?;
   606→        Ok(conn)
   607→    }
   608→}

     2→//!
     3→//! The Coordinator handles:
     4→//! - Peer lifecycle (Connected/Disconnected events from transport)
     5→//! - Spawning PeerActors on new connections
     6→//! - Authentication state tracking
     7→//! - Cross-peer operations (relay, broadcast datagrams)

    10→//! for operations like publishing, subscribing, etc.
    11→//!

    13→//!
    14→//! The Coordinator is generic over `C: Connection` to support different transports:
    15→//! - `Coordinator<IrohConnection>`: Production with NAT traversal
