    39→/// **Used by**: Scribe subscription handling, unsubscription, flush
    40→///
    41→/// State vectors track what each peer has already received.
    42→/// This enables incremental sync (send only what they're missing).
    43→pub trait PeerVectorStorage: Send + Sync {
    44→    /// Load peer's state vectors for all layers
    45→    ///
    46→    /// **Context**: Called when peer subscribes to restore their last known state
    47→    /// **Returns**: HashMap of layer_name -> state_vector bytes, or None if first connection
    48→    fn load_vectors(&self, user_did: &str, device_id: &str)
    49→        -> Result<Option<HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>>>;
    50→
    51→    /// Save peer's state vectors for all layers
    52→    ///
    53→    /// **Context**: Called during flush and on unsubscribe
    54→    /// **Note**: Vectors are stored as-is (Loro's binary format)
    55→    fn save_vectors(
    56→        &self,
    57→        user_did: &str,
    58→        device_id: &str,
    59→        vectors: &HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>,
    60→    ) -> Result<()>;
    61→}
    62→
    63→// Peer Resolver Trait (Node Mode Only)
    64→
    65→/// Peer authorization (node mode only)
    66→///
    67→/// **Implemented by**: Butler's permit store
    68→/// **Used by**: Scribe for node-mode peer lookup and validation
    69→///
    70→/// Only used when Scribe runs on a node (is_node=true).
    71→/// Allows looking up authorized users and their permits.
    72→pub trait PeerResolver: Send + Sync {
    73→    /// List all authorized user_dids for this page
    74→    ///
    75→    /// **Context**: Node mode sync - finding peers to broadcast to
    76→    /// **Returns**: List of DIDs that have permits for this page
    77→    fn list_authorized_users(&self) -> Vec<String>;
    78→
    79→    /// Load a user's permit for this page
    80→    ///
    81→    /// **Context**: Node mode - getting permit for validation/role extraction
    82→    /// **Returns**: Permit token string if user has access, None otherwise
    83→    fn load_user_permit(&self, user_did: &str) -> Option<String>;
    84→}
    85→
    86→// Permit Issuer Trait (Node Mode Only)
    87→
    88→/// Layer permit issuance (node mode only, scoped to a page)
    89→///
    90→/// **Implemented by**: Butler using signing key + gurkha
    91→/// **Used by**: Scribe layer_unit for issuing layer permits on dynamic layer detection
    92→///
    93→/// Scribe must never hold signing keys. This trait abstracts permit creation
    94→/// so Scribe can request permits without accessing crypto directly.
    95→pub trait PermitIssuer: Send + Sync {
    96→    /// Issue a layer permit for a single dynamic layer
    97→    ///
    98→    /// **Context**: Node detected new dynamic layer, needs to issue permits
    99→    /// **Returns**: (permit_token, cid) — ready to store and send
   100→    fn issue_layer_permit(
   101→        &self,
   102→        audience: &str,
   103→        layer_name: &str,
   104→        config: gurkha::LayerConfig,
   105→    ) -> Result<(String, String)>;
   106→}

   109→
   110→/// Reference-counted layer storage
   111→pub type LayerStorageRef = Arc<dyn LayerStorage>;
   112→
   113→/// Reference-counted peer vector storage
   114→pub type PeerVectorStorageRef = Arc<dyn PeerVectorStorage>;

   117→pub type PeerResolverRef = Arc<dyn PeerResolver>;
   118→
   119→/// Reference-counted permit issuer

    16→/// Payload sent to PeerActor for broadcast (3-step sync protocol)

    23→    pub page_id: String,

    27→    pub state_vector: Vec<u8>,

    32→/// Ephemeral broadcast payload (generic)
    33→///
    34→/// **Context**: Scribe sends this to Butler/Courier for datagram broadcast

    51→pub struct EphemeralOutbound {

    58→/// Delta operations for different Loro container types
    59→///
    60→/// **Context**: Represents incremental changes to CRDT containers
    61→/// **Usage**: Lua apps can apply deltas for efficient UI updates (preserve scroll, animations)
    62→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    63→#[serde(tag = "type")]
    64→pub enum LoroDelta {
    65→    /// List delta: sequence of Retain/Insert/Delete operations
    66→    List { ops: Vec<ListOp> },
    67→
    68→    /// Map delta: updated keys
    69→    Map { updated: HashMap<String, Option<serde_json::Value>> },
    70→
    71→    /// Text delta (for future rich text support)
    72→    Text { ops: Vec<TextOp> },
    73→}
    74→
    75→/// List delta operations (applied sequentially)
    76→///
    77→/// **Context**: Represents changes to a Loro list container
    78→/// **Example**: [Retain(3), Insert([msg4]), Delete(1)] means "skip 3 items, insert msg4, delete 1 item"
    79→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    80→#[serde(tag = "op")]
    81→pub enum ListOp {
    82→    /// Keep N items unchanged (advance cursor)
    83→    Retain { count: usize },
    84→
    85→    /// Insert values at current position
    86→    Insert { values: Vec<serde_json::Value> },
    87→
    88→    /// Delete N items at current position
    89→    Delete { count: usize },
    90→}
    91→
    92→/// Text delta operations (for rich text editing)
    93→///
    94→/// **Context**: Represents changes to a Loro text container
    95→/// **Note**: Deferred for now - will implement when we need rich text editing
    96→#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    97→#[serde(tag = "op")]
    98→pub enum TextOp {
    99→    /// Keep N characters unchanged
   100→    Retain { count: usize },
   101→
   102→    /// Insert text at current position
   103→    Insert { text: String },
   104→
   105→    /// Delete N characters at current position
   106→    Delete { count: usize },
   107→}

   109→// Unified Page Update Channel (Replaces PageEvent + EphemeralEvent + QueryDelta)
   110→
   111→/// Unified update enum for all page events
   112→///
   113→/// **Context**: Single channel replaces 3 separate broadcast types
   114→/// **Benefits**: 3 listener tasks → 1, unified fan-out logic
   115→/// **Consumers**: UI/Lua callbacks, Broadcast to peers, Derivation engine
   116→#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
   117→pub enum PageUpdate {
   118→    /// Layer data changed (local edit or remote sync)
   119→    LayerChanged {
   120→        layer: String,
   121→        from_peer: Option<(String, String)>,  // (did, device_id)
   122→        /// Structured operations extracted from the update (same format as validation)
   123→        /// Enables surgical UI updates - Lua can process individual ops
   124→        ops: Option<Vec<JsonOp>>,
   125→        delta: Option<LoroDelta>,
   126→        state_vector: Vec<u8>,
   127→        /// Full layer state as JSON — None when delta is available (avoids O(N) serialization)
   128→        /// Some for initial load, wildcard bindings, or fallback scenarios
   129→        full_data: Option<serde_json::Value>,
   130→        /// True if this is a newly created layer (first time seeing it)
   131→        created: bool,
   132→    },
   133→
   134→    /// Ephemeral data from remote peer (cursor, typing, etc.)
   135→    Ephemeral {
   136→        user_did: String,
   137→        device_id: String,
   138→        payload: Vec<u8>,
   139→    },
   140→
   141→    /// Query result changed
   142→    QueryUpdated {
   143→        query_id: String,
   144→        delta: QueryDelta,
   145→    },
   146→
   147→    /// Peer subscribed to this page
   148→    PeerSubscribed {
   149→        did: String,
   150→        /// Username if presence.share_username is true in their permit
   151→        username: Option<String>,
   152→    },
   153→
   154→    /// Peer unsubscribed from this page
   155→    PeerUnsubscribed {
   156→        did: String,
   157→    },
   158→
   159→    /// Structured ephemeral received (permission-validated)
   160→    ///
   161→    /// **Context**: Ephemeral with func name, validated against permit
   162→    StructuredEphemeral {
   163→        from_did: String,
   164→        func: String,
   165→        args: serde_json::Value,
   166→    },
   167→}

   169→/// Type alias for unified page update channel
   170→pub type PageUpdateTx = mpsc::Sender<PageUpdate>;

   200→pub enum ScribeMessage {

   220→        device_id: String,

   224→    ///
   225→    /// **Context**: Local edit or remote sync push

   229→        update: Vec<u8>,
   230→        /// None = local edit, Some = remote peer
   231→        from_peer: Option<(String, String)>,

   239→    /// **We do**: Permission check, CRDT merge, broadcast to subscribers, reply with result

   271→    GetUpdatesSince {

   227→impl DelegationTemplate {
   228→    /// Convert template to permit facts JSON
   229→    ///
   230→    /// This creates the facts structure that will be embedded in the delegated token.
   231→    /// Role-agnostic: only includes capabilities and patterns, no role-based logic.
   232→    pub fn to_facts(&self) -> serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> {
   233→        let mut facts = serde_json::Map::new();
   234→
   235→        // Add token_type
   236→        facts.insert("token_type".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(self.token_type.clone()));
   237→
   238→        // Add peer_capabilities
   239→        facts.insert("peer_capabilities".to_string(), self.peer_capabilities.to_json());
   240→
   241→        // Add operations (required for delegation chain - e.g., add_pages permission)
   242→        if !self.operations.is_empty() {
   243→            let ops_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.operations
   244→                .iter()
   245→                .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), serde_json::Value::String(v.clone())))
   246→                .collect();
   247→            facts.insert("operations".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(ops_json));
   248→        }
   249→
   250→        // Add auth_capabilities
   251→        if !self.auth_capabilities.is_empty() {
   252→            let auth_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.auth_capabilities
   253→                .iter()
   254→                .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone()))
   255→                .collect();
   256→            facts.insert("auth_capabilities".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(auth_json));
   257→        }
   258→
   259→        // Add layer_patterns
   260→        if !self.layer_patterns.is_empty() {
   261→            let patterns_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.layer_patterns
   262→                .iter()
   263→                .map(|(pattern, config)| {
   264→                    (pattern.clone(), serde_json::json!({
   265→                        "create": config.create,
   266→                        "sync": config.sync,
   267→                        "write": config.write
   268→                    }))
   269→                })
   270→                .collect();
   271→            facts.insert("layer_patterns".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(patterns_json));
   272→        }
   273→
   274→        // Add fixed layers
   275→        if !self.layers.is_empty() {
   276→            let layers_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.layers
   277→                .iter()
   278→                .map(|(name, config)| {
   279→                    let mut layer_obj = serde_json::Map::new();
   280→                    layer_obj.insert("sync".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(config.sync));
   281→                    layer_obj.insert("write".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(config.write));
   282→                    if let Some(ref t) = config.layer_type {
   283→                        layer_obj.insert("type".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(t.clone()));
   284→                    }
   285→                    (name.clone(), serde_json::Value::Object(layer_obj))
   286→                })
   287→                .collect();
   288→            facts.insert("layers".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(layers_json));
   289→        }
   290→
   291→        // Add relationship (for logging only)
   292→        if let Some(rel) = &self.relationship {
   293→            facts.insert("relationship".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(rel.clone()));
   294→        }
   295→
   296→        // Add issue_on (self-describing templates for what to issue on actions)
   297→        if !self.issue_on.is_empty() {
   298→            let issue_on_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.issue_on
   299→                .iter()
   300→                .map(|(action, template)| {
   301→                    (action.clone(), serde_json::Value::Object(template.to_facts()))
   302→                })
   303→                .collect();
   304→            facts.insert("issue_on".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(issue_on_json));
   305→        }
   306→
   307→        // Add presence configuration
   308→        if let Some(ref presence) = self.presence {
   309→            let mut presence_json = serde_json::Map::new();
   310→            presence_json.insert("visible".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(presence.visible));
   311→            presence_json.insert("can_see_others".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(presence.can_see_others));
   312→            if let Some(ref name) = presence.name {
   313→                presence_json.insert("name".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(name.clone()));
   314→            }
   315→            facts.insert("presence".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(presence_json));
   316→        }
   317→
   318→        // Add ephemeral_funcs (allowed ephemeral function names)
   319→        if !self.ephemeral_funcs.is_empty() {
   320→            let funcs: Vec<serde_json::Value> = self.ephemeral_funcs
   321→                .iter()
   322→                .map(|f| serde_json::Value::String(f.clone()))
   323→                .collect();
   324→            facts.insert("ephemeral_funcs".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Array(funcs));
   325→        }
   326→
   327→        // Add dynamic_layer_schemas
   328→        if !self.dynamic_layer_schemas.is_empty() {
   329→            let schemas_json: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = self.dynamic_layer_schemas
   330→                .iter()
   331→                .map(|(pattern, schema)| {
   332→                    (pattern.clone(), serde_json::to_value(schema).unwrap_or_default())
   333→                })
   334→                .collect();
   335→            facts.insert("dynamic_layer_schemas".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Object(schemas_json));
   336→        }
   337→
   338→        facts
   339→    }
   340→}

   343→///
   344→/// The protocol only sees capabilities and patterns, not role labels.
   345→/// Contains all permit data including raw token, parsed UCAN, and extracted facts.
   346→#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
   347→pub struct Permit {
   348→    // Core permit data (merged from PermitCore)
   349→    /// Raw permit token string
   350→    raw_token: String,
   351→    /// Parsed token (uses ucan library internally)
   352→    parsed: Ucan,
   353→    /// Raw facts as JSON (source of truth)
   354→    facts: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
   355→
   356→    // Extracted/parsed fields
   357→    /// Explicit protocol capabilities (relay, share, accept_publish)
   358→    peer_capabilities: PeerCapabilities,
   359→    /// Fixed layer configs (layer_name -> config)
   360→    layers: HashMap<String, LayerConfig>,
   361→    /// Layer patterns for identity-based access (pattern -> config)
   362→    /// Patterns support `{aud}`, `{page_id}` placeholders
   363→    layer_patterns: HashMap<String, LayerPatternConfig>,
   364→    /// Self-describing templates: what to issue when holder takes actions
   365→    /// Keys: "page_request", "share_link", etc.
   366→    issue_on: HashMap<String, DelegationTemplate>,
   367→    /// Parent permit CIDs for delegation chain
   368→    proof_chain: Vec<String>,
   369→    /// Sync behavior facts (local_only, no_incoming_updates, send_full_snapshot)
   370→    sync_facts: SyncFacts,
   371→    /// Presence configuration (visibility, display name)
   372→    presence: Option<PresenceConfig>,
   373→    /// Allowed ephemeral function names (empty = all allowed)
   374→    ephemeral_funcs: Vec<String>,
   375→    /// Schemas for dynamically-created layers (channels, DMs, orders)
   376→    dynamic_layer_schemas: HashMap<String, DynamicLayerSchema>,
   377→}
   378→
   379→impl Permit {
   380→    /// Parse permit token and extract all domain information.
   381→    ///
   382→    /// Role-agnostic: extracts capabilities and patterns, not role labels.
   383→    pub fn from_token(token: &str) -> PermitResult<Self> {
   384→        use tracing::trace;
   385→
   386→        trace!("Parsing permit token (len={})", token.len());
   387→
   388→        // Parse permit token (uses ucan library internally)
   389→        let parsed = Ucan::try_from(token)
   390→            .map_err(|e| PermitError::ParsingFailed(format!("Permit parsing error: {}", e)))?;
   391→
   392→        trace!("JWT decoded - issuer: {}, audience: {}", parsed.issuer(), parsed.audience());
   393→
   394→        // Extract facts as raw JSON (source of truth)
   395→        let facts_ref = parsed.facts().as_ref().ok_or_else(|| {
   396→            PermitError::MissingField("Permit facts not found".to_string())
   397→        })?;
   398→
   399→        // Convert BTreeMap to serde_json::Value for deserialization
   400→        let facts_value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::to_value(facts_ref)
   401→            .map_err(|e| PermitError::ParsingFailed(format!("Facts conversion error: {}", e)))?;
   402→
   403→        // Deserialize structured facts via serde (replaces ~60 lines of manual parsing)
   404→        let parsed_facts: PermitFacts = serde_json::from_value(facts_value.clone())
   405→            .unwrap_or_default();
   406→
   407→        // Keep raw facts map for get_fact() lookups
   408→        let facts: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = facts_ref
   409→            .iter()
   410→            .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone()))
   411→            .collect();
   412→
   413→        trace!(facts = ?facts.keys().collect::<Vec<_>>(), "Facts extracted");
   414→
   415→        // Parse issue_on templates
   416→        let issue_on: HashMap<String, DelegationTemplate> = parsed_facts.issue_on
   417→            .iter()
   418→            .filter_map(|(key, val)| {
   419→                Self::parse_delegation_template(key, val).map(|t| (key.clone(), t))
   420→            })
   421→            .collect();
   422→
   423→        // Extract proof chain
   424→        let proof_chain = parsed.proofs().clone().unwrap_or_default();
   425→
   426→        Ok(Self {
   427→            raw_token: token.to_string(),
   428→            parsed,
   429→            facts,
   430→            peer_capabilities: parsed_facts.peer_capabilities,
   431→            layers: parsed_facts.layers,
   432→            layer_patterns: parsed_facts.layer_patterns,
   433→            issue_on,
   434→            proof_chain,
   435→            sync_facts: parsed_facts.sync,
   436→            presence: parsed_facts.presence,
   437→            ephemeral_funcs: parsed_facts.ephemeral_funcs,
   438→            dynamic_layer_schemas: parsed_facts.dynamic_layer_schemas,
   439→        })
   440→    }
   441→
   442→    /// Parse a DelegationTemplate from a JSON value
   443→    fn parse_delegation_template(key: &str, template_val: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<DelegationTemplate> {
   444→        let template_obj = template_val.as_object()?;
   445→
   446→        // Extract token_type
   447→        let token_type = template_obj
   448→            .get("token_type")
   449→            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
   450→            .map(String::from)
   451→            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("delegated_{}", key));
   452→
   453→        // Extract peer_capabilities
   454→        let peer_capabilities = template_obj
   455→            .get("peer_capabilities")
   456→            .and_then(|v| v.as_object())
   457→            .map(PeerCapabilities::from_json)
   458→            .unwrap_or_default();
   459→
   460→        // Extract layer_patterns
   461→        let mut layer_patterns = HashMap::new();
   462→        if let Some(patterns_obj) = template_obj.get("layer_patterns").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   463→            for (pattern, config) in patterns_obj {
   464→                if let Some(config_obj) = config.as_object() {
   465→                    layer_patterns.insert(
   466→                        pattern.clone(),
   467→                        LayerPatternConfig {
   468→                            create: config_obj.get("create").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   469→                            sync: config_obj.get("sync").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   470→                            write: config_obj.get("write").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   471→                        },
   472→                    );
   473→                }
   474→            }
   475→        }
   476→
   477→        // Extract fixed layers
   478→        let mut layers = HashMap::new();
   479→        if let Some(layers_obj) = template_obj.get("layers").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   480→            for (layer_name, layer_val) in layers_obj {
   481→                if let Some(layer_obj) = layer_val.as_object() {
   482→                    layers.insert(layer_name.clone(), LayerConfig {
   483→                        sync: layer_obj.get("sync").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   484→                        write: layer_obj.get("write").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   485→                        layer_type: layer_obj.get("type").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).map(String::from),
   486→                    });
   487→                }
   488→            }
   489→        }
   490→
   491→        // Extract relationship (for logging only)
   492→        let relationship = template_obj
   493→            .get("relationship")
   494→            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
   495→            .map(String::from);
   496→
   497→        // Extract operations (e.g., add_pages, share_page)
   498→        let mut operations = HashMap::new();
   499→        if let Some(ops_obj) = template_obj.get("operations").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   500→            for (op_name, op_val) in ops_obj {
   501→                if let Some(op_str) = op_val.as_str() {
   502→                    operations.insert(op_name.clone(), op_str.to_string());
   503→                }
   504→            }
   505→        }
   506→
   507→        // Extract auth_capabilities (can_connect, sync_enabled, etc.)
   508→        let mut auth_capabilities = HashMap::new();
   509→        if let Some(auth_obj) = template_obj.get("auth_capabilities").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   510→            for (cap_name, cap_val) in auth_obj {
   511→                auth_capabilities.insert(cap_name.clone(), cap_val.clone());
   512→            }
   513→        }
   514→
   515→        // Extract issue_on (recursive - templates for what to issue on actions)
   516→        let mut issue_on = HashMap::new();
   517→        if let Some(issue_on_obj) = template_obj.get("issue_on").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   518→            for (action_key, nested_template_val) in issue_on_obj {
   519→                if let Some(nested_template) = Self::parse_delegation_template(action_key, nested_template_val) {
   520→                    issue_on.insert(action_key.clone(), Box::new(nested_template));
   521→                }
   522→            }
   523→        }
   524→
   525→        // Extract presence configuration
   526→        let presence = template_obj.get("presence").and_then(|v| v.as_object()).map(|p| {
   527→            PresenceConfig {
   528→                visible: p.get("visible").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false),
   529→                can_see_others: p.get("can_see_others").and_then(|v| v.as_bool()).unwrap_or(true),
   530→                name: p.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).map(String::from),
   531→            }
   532→        });
   533→
   534→        // Extract ephemeral_funcs
   535→        let ephemeral_funcs = template_obj.get("ephemeral_funcs")
   536→            .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
   537→            .map(|arr| {
   538→                arr.iter()
   539→                    .filter_map(|v| v.as_str().map(String::from))
   540→                    .collect()
   541→            })
   542→            .unwrap_or_default();
   543→
   544→        // Extract dynamic_layer_schemas
   545→        let mut dynamic_layer_schemas = HashMap::new();
   546→        if let Some(schemas_obj) = template_obj.get("dynamic_layer_schemas").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
   547→            for (pattern, schema_val) in schemas_obj {
   548→                if let Ok(schema) = serde_json::from_value::<DynamicLayerSchema>(schema_val.clone()) {
   549→                    dynamic_layer_schemas.insert(pattern.clone(), schema);
   550→                }
   551→            }
   552→        }
   553→
   554→        Some(DelegationTemplate {
   555→            token_type,
   556→            peer_capabilities,
   557→            operations,
   558→            auth_capabilities,
   559→            layer_patterns,
   560→            layers,
   561→            relationship,
   562→            issue_on,
   563→            presence,
   564→            ephemeral_funcs,
   565→            dynamic_layer_schemas,
   566→        })
   567→    }

   810→    /// Check if a layer should sync based on permit configuration
   811→    ///
   812→    /// **Context**: Used to filter out local-only layers (sync: false)
   813→    /// **Checks**: Layer lookup in `layers` section - check `sync` flag
   814→    /// **Returns**: true if layer should sync, false if local-only
   815→    ///
   816→    /// With fully-resolved permits, layer names in the permit are already
   817→    /// expanded (e.g., "abc123/products" not "{page_id}/products").
   818→    pub fn should_sync_layer(&self, layer_name: &str, page_id: &str, _our_did: &str) -> bool {
   819→        // Check direct match
   820→        if let Some(config) = self.layers.get(layer_name) {
   821→            return config.sync;
   822→        }
   823→        // Check with page_id prefix (for bare names like "products")
   824→        let full_name = format!("{}/{}", page_id, layer_name);
   825→        if let Some(config) = self.layers.get(&full_name) {
   826→            return config.sync;
   827→        }
   828→        // Default: sync
   829→        true
   830→    }

   832→    /// Check if permit allows writing to a layer
   833→    ///
   834→    /// **Checks**: Layer lookup for write=true, then schema fallback for creator access
   835→    ///
   836→    /// With fully-resolved permits, accepts both bare names ("products")
   837→    /// and full names ("abc123/products"). For dynamic layers, falls back
   838→    /// to schema matching if the creator's DID is in the layer path.
   839→    pub fn can_write_layer(&self, layer_name: &str, page_id: &str, our_did: &str) -> bool {
   840→        // Direct match
   841→        if let Some(config) = self.layers.get(layer_name) {
   842→            return config.write;
   843→        }
   844→        // Try with page_id prefix
   845→        let full_name = format!("{}/{}", page_id, layer_name);
   846→        if let Some(config) = self.layers.get(&full_name) {
   847→            return config.write;
   848→        }
   849→        // Schema fallback for creator access to dynamic layers
   850→        if crate::decision::matches_creator_schema(self, layer_name, page_id, our_did, "write") {
   851→            return true;
   852→        }
   853→        false
   854→    }

   862→    /// is in the layer path.
   863→    pub fn can_read_layer(&self, layer_name: &str, page_id: &str, our_did: &str) -> bool {
   864→        // Direct match
   865→        if let Some(config) = self.layers.get(layer_name) {
   866→            return config.sync;

   868→        // Try with page_id prefix
   869→        let full_name = format!("{}/{}", page_id, layer_name);
   870→        if let Some(config) = self.layers.get(&full_name) {

   873→        // Schema fallback for creator access to dynamic layers

   876→        }
   877→        false
   878→    }

   903→fn strip_page_prefix(expanded: &str, page_id: &str) -> String {

   914→/// - `{aud}` → replaced with did

   920→        .replace("{aud}", did)
   921→}

   925→/// Replaces {page_id} in layer keys at all levels (top-level and nested issue_on).
   926→/// Also removes `layer_patterns` from facts (replaced by dynamic_layer_schemas).
   927→pub fn resolve_page_id_in_facts(facts: &mut serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>, page_id: &str) {
   928→    // Resolve top-level layers
   929→    if let Some(layers) = facts.remove("layers") {
   930→        if let Some(layers_obj) = layers.as_object() {

   946→            let mut resolved_issue_on = serde_json::Map::new();
   947→            for (action, template_val) in issue_on_obj {
   948→                if let Some(mut template_obj) = template_val.as_object().cloned() {
   949→                    resolve_page_id_in_facts(&mut template_obj, page_id);

   954→            }

1→-- Group Chat App — Slack-like with channels, threads, reactions
     2→-- Entry point: on_init, on_click routing, presence, typing
     3→
     4→local channels = require("channels")
     5→local messages = require("messages")
     6→local threads = require("threads")
     7→local helpers = require("ui_helpers")
     8→local read_tracker = require("read_tracker")
     9→
    10→local presence = presence_lib
    11→
    12→-- State
    13→local page_id = nil
    14→local my_did = nil
    15→local my_name = nil
    16→
    17→-- Typing indicator state
    18→local typing_users = {}
    19→local last_typing_sent = 0
    20→
    21→-- Emoji shortcodes (for reaction via context menu)
    22→local EMOJI_SHORTCODES = {
    23→    Smile = "grinning_face", Laugh = "joy", Heart = "heart", Thumbs = "thumbsup",
    24→    Fire = "fire", Party = "tada", Rocket = "rocket", Star = "star",
    25→    Check = "white_check_mark", Wave = "wave", Eyes = "eyes", Think = "thinking",
    26→    Clap = "clap", ["100"] = "100", Sad = "cry", Angry = "angry",
    27→    Cool = "sunglasses", Wink = "wink", LOL = "rofl", Love = "heart_eyes",
    28→    Sparkles = "sparkles", Pray = "pray", Muscle = "muscle", Tada = "confetti_ball",
    29→    Crown = "crown", Gem = "gem_stone", Lightning = "zap", Trophy = "trophy",
    30→    Brain = "brain", Ghost = "ghost",
    31→}
    32→
    33→function on_init()
    34→    page_id = scribe:page_id()
    35→    my_did = scribe:my_did()
    36→    my_name = USERNAME or scribe:my_name() or my_did:sub(-8)
    37→
    38→    -- Init modules
    39→    messages.init(my_did, my_name)
    40→    threads.init(my_did, my_name)
    41→    read_tracker.init(page_id, my_did, my_name)
    42→
    43→    -- Init presence
    44→    presence.init(page_id, my_did, my_name)
    45→
    46→    -- Set profile footer state
    47→    ui:set("my_display_name", my_name)
    48→    ui:set("my_online", true)
    49→
    50→    -- Bind presence to online users sidebar
    51→    scribe:bind("online_users", "presence", {
    52→        key = "did",
    53→        transform = function(entry)
    54→            if not entry or not entry.did then return nil end
    55→            return {
    56→                did = entry.did:sub(-8),
    57→                name = entry.name or entry.did:sub(-8),
    58→                is_online = entry.status == "online",
    59→            }
    60→        end
    61→    })
    62→
    63→    -- Init channels — callback fires on every channel switch (including initial "general")
    64→    local messages_bound = false
    65→    channels.init(page_id, my_did, my_name, function(channel_id, layer_path)
    66→        -- First call: create binding. Subsequent calls: rebind to new layer.
    67→        if not messages_bound then
    68→            scribe:bind("messages", layer_path, {
    69→                key = "id",
    70→                transform = function(msg)
    71→                    if msg.thread_parent_id and msg.thread_parent_id ~= "" then
    72→                        return nil  -- filter thread replies from main view
    73→                    end
    74→                    return messages.to_ui_message(msg)
    75→                end
    76→            })
    77→            messages_bound = true
    78→        else
    79→            scribe:rebind("messages", layer_path)
    80→        end
    81→
    82→        -- Refresh thread if open (may be in same channel)
    83→        if threads.is_open() then
    84→            threads.refresh_replies(channels.get_messages_layer())
    85→        end
    86→
    87→        -- Mark as read and update sidebar badges
    88→        read_tracker.mark_read(channel_id, channels.get_messages_layer())
    89→        channels.refresh_channel_list()
    90→    end, read_tracker)
    91→
    92→    -- Init UI state
    93→    ui:set("auto_scroll", true)
    94→    ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
    95→    ui:set("replying_to_id", "")
    96→    ui:set("replying_to_text", "")
    97→    ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
    98→    ui:set("thread_open", false)
    99→    ui:set("thread_draft", "")
   100→
   101→    -- Initial read tracking (binding handles UI sync)
   102→    refresh_messages()
   103→end
   104→
   105→-- Refresh messages side effects (read tracking + badges)
   106→-- The binding system handles UI sync; this only does read-tracking
   107→function refresh_messages()
   108→    local layer = channels.get_messages_layer()
   109→    read_tracker.mark_read(channels.get_active_channel(), layer)
   110→    channels.refresh_channel_list()
   111→end
   112→
   113→function on_click(target)
   114→    -- Sidebar collapse toggles
   115→    if target == "toggle_channels" then
   116→        ui:set("channels_collapsed", not ui:get("channels_collapsed"))
   117→        return
   118→    end
   119→    if target == "toggle_online" then
   120→        ui:set("online_collapsed", not ui:get("online_collapsed"))
   121→        return
   122→    end
   123→
   124→    -- Channel switching
   125→    if target:match("^switch_channel:") then
   126→        local id = target:sub(16)
   127→        channels.switch_channel(id)
   128→        -- Close thread when switching channels
   129→        threads.close()
   130→        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
   131→        ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
   132→        return
   133→    end
   134→
   135→    -- Thread operations
   136→    if target:match("^open_thread:") then
   137→        local msg_id = target:sub(13)
   138→        threads.open(channels.get_messages_layer(), msg_id)
   139→        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
   140→        return
   141→    end
   142→
   143→    if target == "close_thread" then
   144→        threads.close()
   145→        return
   146→    end
   147→
   148→    if target == "thread_submit" then
   149→        threads.send_reply(channels.get_messages_layer())
   150→        refresh_messages()
   151→        return
   152→    end
   153→
   154→    -- Reactions
   155→    if target:match("^toggle_reaction:") then
   156→        local parts = {}
   157→        for part in target:gmatch("[^:]+") do table.insert(parts, part) end
   158→        if #parts >= 3 then
   159→            messages.toggle_reaction(channels.get_messages_layer(), parts[2], parts[3])
   160→            refresh_messages()
   161→            if threads.is_open() then
   162→                threads.refresh_replies(channels.get_messages_layer())
   163→            end
   164→        end
   165→        return
   166→    end
   167→
   168→    if target:match("^add_reaction:") then
   169→        local msg_id = target:sub(14)
   170→        ui:set("selected_message_id", msg_id)
   171→        ui:set("show_emoji_picker", true)
   172→        return
   173→    end
   174→
   175→    -- Context menu
   176→    if target:match("^toggle_menu:") then
   177→        local msg_id = target:sub(13)
   178→        local current = ui:get("selected_message_id") or ""
   179→        if current == msg_id then
   180→            ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
   181→        else
   182→            ui:set("selected_message_id", msg_id)
   183→        end
   184→        return
   185→    end
   186→
   187→    if target == "context_menu:reply" then
   188→        local msg_id = ui:get("selected_message_id") or ""
   189→        local raw = messages.get_raw(channels.get_messages_layer(), msg_id)
   190→        if raw then
   191→            ui:set("replying_to_id", msg_id)
   192→            ui:set("replying_to_text", helpers.truncate_text(raw.text, 40))
   193→        end
   194→        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
   195→        return
   196→    end
   197→
   198→    if target == "context_menu:thread" then
   199→        local msg_id = ui:get("selected_message_id") or ""
   200→        threads.open(channels.get_messages_layer(), msg_id)
   201→        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
   202→        return
   203→    end
   204→
   205→    -- Edit message
   206→    if target:match("^edit_message:") then
   207→        local msg_id = target:sub(14)
   208→        local raw = messages.get_raw(channels.get_messages_layer(), msg_id)
   209→        if raw and raw.sender_did == my_did then
   210→            -- Put text in draft for editing (simple approach)
   211→            ui:set("draft_text", raw.text)
   212→            ui:set("replying_to_id", "edit:" .. msg_id)
   213→            ui:set("replying_to_text", "Editing message...")
   214→        end
   215→        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
   216→        return
   217→    end
   218→
   219→    -- Delete message
   220→    if target:match("^delete_message:") then
   221→        local msg_id = target:sub(16)
   222→        messages.delete(channels.get_messages_layer(), msg_id)
   223→        ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
   224→        refresh_messages()
   225→        if threads.is_open() then
   226→            threads.refresh_replies(channels.get_messages_layer())
   227→        end
   228→        return
   229→    end
   230→
   231→    -- Emoji picker
   232→    if target == "emoji_picker:toggle" then
   233→        ui:set("show_emoji_picker", not ui:get("show_emoji_picker"))
   234→        return
   235→    end
   236→
   237→    if target == "emoji_picker:close" then
   238→        ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
   239→        return
   240→    end
   241→
   242→    if target:match("^emoji:") then
   243→        local emoji_name = target:sub(7)
   244→        local selected = ui:get("selected_message_id") or ""
   245→        if selected ~= "" then
   246→            -- Add reaction to selected message
   247→            local emoji_char = messages.resolve_emoji(emoji_name)
   248→            messages.toggle_reaction(channels.get_messages_layer(), selected, emoji_char)
   249→            ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
   250→            ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
   251→            refresh_messages()
   252→            if threads.is_open() then
   253→                threads.refresh_replies(channels.get_messages_layer())
   254→            end
   255→        else
   256→            -- Insert into draft text
   257→            messages.insert_emoji_to_draft(emoji_name)
   258→            ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
   259→        end
   260→        return
   261→    end
   262→
   263→    -- Reply cancel
   264→    if target == "cancel_reply" then
   265→        ui:set("replying_to_id", "")
   266→        ui:set("replying_to_text", "")
   267→        return
   268→    end
   269→
   270→    -- Autoscroll
   271→    if target == "toggle_autoscroll" then
   272→        ui:set("auto_scroll", not ui:get("auto_scroll"))
   273→        return
   274→    end
   275→
   276→    -- Attach file
   277→    if target == "attach_file" then
   278→        pick_asset_file("images")
   279→        return
   280→    end
   281→
   282→    -- Create channel modal
   283→    if target == "create_channel" then
   284→        ui:set("new_channel_name", "")
   285→        ui:set("show_create_channel", true)
   286→        return
   287→    end
   288→
   289→    if target == "cancel_create_channel" then
   290→        ui:set("show_create_channel", false)
   291→        ui:set("new_channel_name", "")
   292→        return
   293→    end
   294→
   295→    if target == "confirm_create_channel" then
   296→        local name = ui:get("new_channel_name") or ""
   297→        if name ~= "" then
   298→            channels.create_channel(name)
   299→        end
   300→        ui:set("show_create_channel", false)
   301→        ui:set("new_channel_name", "")
   302→        return
   303→    end
   304→end
   305→
   306→function on_submit()
   307→    local text = ui:get("draft_text")
   308→    if not text or text == "" then return end
   309→
   310→    local replying_to = ui:get("replying_to_id") or ""
   311→
   312→    -- Check if editing
   313→    if replying_to:match("^edit:") then
   314→        local msg_id = replying_to:sub(6)
   315→        messages.edit(channels.get_messages_layer(), msg_id, text)
   316→        ui:set("draft_text", "")
   317→        ui:set("replying_to_id", "")
   318→        ui:set("replying_to_text", "")
   319→        refresh_messages()
   320→        return
   321→    end
   322→
   323→    -- Normal send
   324→    local reply_preview = ui:get("replying_to_text") or ""
   325→    messages.send(channels.get_messages_layer(), text, replying_to, reply_preview)
   326→
   327→    ui:set("draft_text", "")
   328→    ui:set("show_emoji_picker", false)
   329→    ui:set("replying_to_id", "")
   330→    ui:set("replying_to_text", "")
   331→    ui:set("selected_message_id", "")
   332→
   333→    refresh_messages()
   334→end
   335→
   336→function on_text_input(text)
   337→    local now = os.time()
   338→    if now - last_typing_sent >= 2 then
   339→        scribe:send("typing", { user = my_name, channel = channels.get_active_channel() })
   340→        last_typing_sent = now
   341→    end
   342→end
   343→
   344→function on_ephemeral(user_did, func, args)
   345→    if func == "typing" and user_did ~= my_did then
   346→        -- Only show typing for current channel
   347→        if args and args.channel == channels.get_active_channel() then
   348→            local user = args.user or user_did:sub(-8)
   349→            typing_users[user_did] = { timestamp = os.time(), name = user }
   350→            refresh_typing_indicator()
   351→        end
   352→    end
   353→end
   354→
   355→function refresh_typing_indicator()
   356→    local now = os.time()
   357→    local active = {}
   358→    local stale = {}
   359→
   360→    for did, info in pairs(typing_users) do
   361→        if now - info.timestamp < 3 then
   362→            table.insert(active, info.name)
   363→        else
   364→            table.insert(stale, did)
   365→        end
   366→    end
   367→
   368→    for _, did in ipairs(stale) do
   369→        typing_users[did] = nil
   370→    end
   371→
   372→    if #active == 0 then
   373→        ui:set("typing_text", "")
   374→    elseif #active == 1 then
   375→        ui:set("typing_text", active[1] .. " is typing...")
   376→    else
   377→        ui:set("typing_text", #active .. " people typing...")
   378→    end
   379→end
   380→
   381→-- Asset upload callback
   382→function on_asset_uploaded(asset)
   383→    if asset and asset.hash then
   384→        messages.send_with_attachment(
   385→            channels.get_messages_layer(),
   386→            "[File: " .. (asset.filename or "file") .. "]",
   387→            asset.hash,
   388→            asset.filename or "file"
   389→        )
   390→        refresh_messages()
   391→    end
   392→end
   393→
   394→-- Layer change callback for non-bound layers (channels_meta, read_positions, etc.)
   395→-- Bound layers (messages, presence) are handled by the binding system automatically.
   396→function on_loro_change(layer_name)
   397→    if layer_name:match("channels_meta") then
   398→        channels.refresh_channel_list()
   399→        return
   400→    end
   401→
   402→    if layer_name:match("read_positions") then
   403→        channels.refresh_channel_list()
   404→        return
   405→    end
   406→
   407→    -- Active channel messages changed (handles read tracking + thread refresh)
   408→    local active_path = channels.get_active_layer_path()
   409→    if active_path and layer_name:sub(-#active_path) == active_path then
   410→        refresh_messages()
   411→        if threads.is_open() then
   412→            threads.refresh_replies(channels.get_messages_layer())
   413→        end
   414→    end
   415→end
   416→
   417→-- Periodic typing cleanup
   418→timer.setInterval(1000, function()
   419→    refresh_typing_indicator()
   420→end)
   421→
   422→-- API exports
   423→api.export("send_message", function(text)
   424→    messages.send(channels.get_messages_layer(), text)
   425→    refresh_messages()
   426→end)
   427→api.export("switch_channel", function(id) channels.switch_channel(id) end)
   428→api.export("get_active_channel", function() return channels.get_active_channel() end)
   429→api.export("get_message_count", function()
   430→    local layer = channels.get_messages_layer()
   431→    if not layer then return 0 end
   432→    return layer:length()
   433→end)

1→-- Channels — switch, create, ensure defaults
     2→-- Default channels (general/random/dev) are static layers in the permit template.
     3→-- Custom user-created channels use create_layer() for DID-namespaced dynamic layers.
     4→
     5→local M = {}
     6→
     7→-- Module state (set by init)
     8→local page_id = nil
     9→local my_did = nil
    10→local my_name = nil
    11→local channels_meta_layer = nil
    12→local active_channel = "general"
    13→
    14→-- Current channel's messages layer (LoroMap)
    15→local messages_layer = nil
    16→
    17→-- Current channel's bare layer path (for binding/rebinding)
    18→local active_layer_path = nil
    19→
    20→-- Callback to refresh messages when channel changes
    21→local on_channel_switch = nil
    22→
    23→-- Read tracker module reference (set by init)
    24→local read_tracker = nil
    25→
    26→-- Default channels — these are static layers in the permit template
    27→local DEFAULT_CHANNELS = {
    28→    { id = "general", name = "general", topic = "General discussion" },
    29→    { id = "random", name = "random", topic = "Random stuff" },
    30→    { id = "dev", name = "dev", topic = "Development talk" },
    31→}
    32→
    33→-- Check if a channel ID is a default (static) channel
    34→local function is_default_channel(channel_id)
    35→    for _, ch in ipairs(DEFAULT_CHANNELS) do
    36→        if ch.id == channel_id then return true end
    37→    end
    38→    return false
    39→end
    40→
    41→-- Get the layer path for a channel.
    42→-- Default channels: simple static path (e.g., "channels/general/messages")
    43→-- Custom channels: DID-namespaced path stored in channels_meta
    44→local function get_channel_layer_path(channel_id)
    45→    if is_default_channel(channel_id) then
    46→        return "channels/" .. channel_id .. "/messages"
    47→    end
    48→    -- Custom channel: read DID-namespaced path from meta
    49→    local ch_meta = channels_meta_layer and channels_meta_layer:get(channel_id)
    50→    if ch_meta and ch_meta.layer_path then
    51→        return ch_meta.layer_path
    52→    end
    53→    -- Fallback for channels without stored path
    54→    return "channels/" .. channel_id .. "/messages"
    55→end
    56→
    57→function M.init(pid, did, name, callback, tracker)
    58→    page_id = pid
    59→    my_did = did
    60→    my_name = name
    61→    on_channel_switch = callback
    62→    read_tracker = tracker
    63→
    64→    channels_meta_layer = scribe:map(page_id .. "/channels_meta")
    65→
    66→    M.ensure_default_channels()
    67→    M.switch_channel("general")
    68→end
    69→
    70→function M.ensure_default_channels()
    71→    if not channels_meta_layer then return end
    72→
    73→    for _, ch in ipairs(DEFAULT_CHANNELS) do
    74→        local existing = channels_meta_layer:get(ch.id)
    75→        if not existing then
    76→            -- Default channels use simple static paths (no create_layer needed)
    77→            channels_meta_layer:set(ch.id, {
    78→                id = ch.id,
    79→                name = ch.name,
    80→                topic = ch.topic,
    81→                created_by = my_did,
    82→                created_at = os.time(),
    83→            })
    84→        end
    85→    end
    86→
    87→    M.refresh_channel_list()
    88→end
    89→
    90→function M.refresh_channel_list()
    91→    if not channels_meta_layer then return end
    92→
    93→    local channel_list = {}
    94→    local keys = channels_meta_layer:keys()
    95→    if keys then
    96→        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
    97→            local ch = channels_meta_layer:get(key)
    98→            if ch then
    99→                local ch_id = ch.id or key
   100→                local unread = 0
   101→                local has_mention = false
   102→                if read_tracker then
   103→                    local ch_layer_path = get_channel_layer_path(ch_id)
   104→                    local ch_msgs_layer = scribe:map(page_id .. "/" .. ch_layer_path)
   105→                    unread, has_mention = read_tracker.count_unread(ch_id, ch_msgs_layer)
   106→                end
   107→                local is_active = ch_id == active_channel
   108→                table.insert(channel_list, {
   109→                    id = ch_id,
   110→                    name = ch.name or key,
   111→                    topic = ch.topic or "",
   112→                    unread = is_active and 0 or unread,
   113→                    is_active = is_active,
   114→                    has_mention = is_active and false or has_mention,
   115→                })
   116→            end
   117→        end
   118→    end
   119→
   120→    -- Sort alphabetically, but keep "general" first
   121→    table.sort(channel_list, function(a, b)
   122→        if a.id == "general" then return true end
   123→        if b.id == "general" then return false end
   124→        return a.name < b.name
   125→    end)
   126→
   127→    ui:set("channels", channel_list)
   128→end

   130→function M.switch_channel(channel_id)
   131→    active_channel = channel_id
   132→
   133→    local layer_path = get_channel_layer_path(channel_id)
   134→    active_layer_path = layer_path
   135→
   136→    -- Get messages layer using the full path
   137→    messages_layer = scribe:map(page_id .. "/" .. layer_path)
   138→
   139→    -- Mark as read immediately on switch
   140→    if read_tracker then
   141→        read_tracker.mark_read(channel_id, messages_layer)
   142→    end
   143→
   144→    -- Update UI
   145→    local ch_meta = channels_meta_layer and channels_meta_layer:get(channel_id)
   146→    ui:set("active_channel", channel_id)
   147→    ui:set("active_channel_topic", ch_meta and ch_meta.topic or "")
   148→
   149→    -- Refresh channel list (to update active state)
   150→    M.refresh_channel_list()
   151→
   152→    -- Notify parent with layer_path (for binding/rebinding)
   153→    if on_channel_switch then
   154→        on_channel_switch(channel_id, layer_path)
   155→    end
   156→end

   158→function M.create_channel(name)
   159→    if not name or name == "" then return end
   160→    if not channels_meta_layer then return end
   161→
   162→    -- Sanitize: lowercase, replace spaces with hyphens
   163→    local id = name:lower():gsub("%s+", "-"):gsub("[^%w%-]", "")
   164→    if id == "" then return end
   165→
   166→    -- Check if already exists
   167→    local existing = channels_meta_layer:get(id)
   168→    if existing then
   169→        M.switch_channel(id)
   170→        return
   171→    end
   172→
   173→    -- Custom channels use create_layer() for DID-namespaced dynamic path
   174→    local result = scribe:create_layer("channels/{id}/messages", id)
   175→    local layer_path = nil
   176→    if result and result.layer_name then
   177→        -- Strip page_id/ prefix to get bare path
   178→        local prefix = page_id .. "/"
   179→        if result.layer_name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
   180→            layer_path = result.layer_name:sub(#prefix + 1)
   181→        else
   182→            layer_path = result.layer_name
   183→        end
   184→    end
   185→
   186→    channels_meta_layer:set(id, {
   187→        id = id,
   188→        name = id,
   189→        topic = "",
   190→        created_by = my_did,
   191→        created_at = os.time(),
   192→        layer_path = layer_path,
   193→    })
   194→
   195→    M.refresh_channel_list()
   196→    M.switch_channel(id)
   197→end
   198→
   199→function M.get_active_channel()
   200→    return active_channel
   201→end
   202→
   203→function M.get_active_layer_path()
   204→    return active_layer_path
   205→end
   206→
   207→function M.get_messages_layer()
   208→    return messages_layer
   209→end
   210→
   211→function M.get_channels_meta_layer()
   212→    return channels_meta_layer
   213→end
   214→

1→#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2→"""
     3→Remote Connection Test — sets up owner + node, prints connection string for external peer.
     4→
     5→Starts one owner and one node on the local machine. The owner creates a space,
     6→connects to the node, publishes, and generates a shareable link. The script then
     7→prints the connection string and diagnostic info (endpoint addr, relay URLs) so
     8→you can share it with someone outside the network.
     9→
    10→The script stays alive waiting for the remote peer to connect.
    11→
    12→Usage:
    13→    python scripts/test_remote_connect.py
    14→    python scripts/test_remote_connect.py --app-path sample_apps/osvauld-demos --app-name "Group Chat"
    15→    python scripts/test_remote_connect.py --keep    # keep instances running after Ctrl+C
    16→    python scripts/test_remote_connect.py --release  # use release binary
    17→"""
    18→
    19→import argparse
    20→import base64
    21→import json
    22→import signal
    23→import sys
    24→import time
    25→from pathlib import Path
    26→
    27→sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
    28→
    29→from osvauld.scenario import Scenario
    30→
    31→
    32→def parse_args():
    33→    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Remote Connection Test")
    34→    parser.add_argument("--keep", action="store_true", help="Keep instances running on exit")
    35→    parser.add_argument("--app-path", type=str, default=None, help="Path to app directory to import")
    36→    parser.add_argument("--app-name", type=str, default=None, help="App name to open after setup")
    37→    parser.add_argument("--release", action="store_true", help="Use release binary")
    38→    parser.add_argument("--fresh", action="store_true", default=True, help="Clean data dirs (default: True)")
    39→    parser.add_argument("--no-fresh", action="store_false", dest="fresh", help="Keep existing data dirs")
    40→    return parser.parse_args()
    41→
    42→
    43→def decode_connection_string(conn_str: str) -> dict:
    44→    """Decode base64 connection string to inspect its contents."""
    45→    try:
    46→        decoded = json.loads(base64.b64decode(conn_str))
    47→        return decoded
    48→    except Exception as e:
    49→        return {"error": str(e)}
    50→
    51→
    52→def main():
    53→    args = parse_args()
    54→    scenario = Scenario(owner=1, node=1, passphrase="test123", fresh=args.fresh)
    55→
    56→    keep = args.keep
    57→
    58→    def signal_handler(sig, frame):
    59→        print("\n\nShutting down...")
    60→        if not keep:
    61→            scenario.stop()
    62→        else:
    63→            print("--keep flag set, instances still running")
    64→            print(f"  Node socket: {scenario.node.socket_path}")
    65→            print(f"  Owner socket: {scenario.owner.socket_path}")
    66→        sys.exit(0)
    67→
    68→    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)
    69→
    70→    try:
    71→        print("=" * 60)
    72→        print("  Remote Connection Test")
    73→        print("=" * 60)
    74→
    75→        # Start node + owner
    76→        print("\n[1/5] Starting node and owner...")
    77→        scenario.start()
    78→
    79→        node = scenario.node
    80→        owner = scenario.owner
    81→
    82→        print(f"  Node started: {node.name}")
    83→        print(f"  Owner started: {owner.name}")
    84→
    85→        # Signup owner
    86→        print("\n[2/5] Signing up owner...")
    87→        owner.client.signup_or_login("alice", "test123")
    88→        print("  Owner signed up as 'alice'")
    89→
    90→        # Get node connection string and diagnostics
    91→        print("\n[3/5] Getting node diagnostics...")
    92→        node_conn_str = node.connection_string
    93→        node_details = decode_connection_string(node_conn_str)
    94→
    95→        print(f"  Node name: {node_details.get('name', 'unknown')}")
    96→        print(f"  Relay URL: {node_details.get('relay', 'NONE')}")
    97→        if node_details.get("device_public_key"):
    98→            key_bytes = base64.b64decode(node_details["device_public_key"])
    99→            node_id_hex = key_bytes.hex()
   100→            print(f"  Node ID: {node_id_hex}")
   101→
   102→        # Owner connects to node
   103→        print("\n[4/5] Owner connecting to node...")
   104→        result = owner.client.connect_to_node(node)
   105→        nodes = owner.client.list_nodes()
   106→        if nodes:
   107→            node_id = nodes[0].get("node_id", "")
   108→            print(f"  Connected to node: {node_id[:16]}...")
   109→
   110→            # Wait for auth
   111→            print("  Waiting for authentication...")
   112→            if owner.client.wait_for_node_auth(node_id, timeout=30):
   113→                print("  Authenticated with node")
   114→            else:
   115→                print("  WARNING: Auth timeout (continuing anyway)")
   116→
   117→            # Create space + import page if app path given
   118→            if args.app_path:
   119→                print(f"\n  Importing app from {args.app_path}...")
   120→                space_result = owner.client.create_space_with_pages(args.app_path)
   121→                space_id = space_result.get("space_id", "")
   122→                print(f"  Space created: {space_id[:16]}...")
   123→
   124→                # Publish space to node
   125→                print("  Publishing space to node...")
   126→                owner.client.publish_space(space_id, node_id)
   127→                time.sleep(2)  # wait for publish
   128→
   129→                # Get shareable link
   130→                print("\n[5/5] Generating shareable link...")
   131→                viewer_link = owner.client.get_shareable_link(space_id, node_id)
   132→                viewer_details = decode_connection_string(viewer_link)
   133→
   134→                print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
   135→                print("  SHAREABLE LINK (give this to remote peer)")
   136→                print(f"{'=' * 60}")
   137→                print(f"\n{viewer_link}\n")
   138→                print(f"{'=' * 60}")
   139→
   140→                print(f"\n  Link details:")
   141→                print(f"    Relay: {viewer_details.get('relay', 'NONE')}")
   142→                if viewer_details.get("device_public_key"):
   143→                    vk_bytes = base64.b64decode(viewer_details["device_public_key"])
   144→                    print(f"    Node ID: {vk_bytes.hex()}")
   145→
   146→                if args.app_name:
   147→                    # Open app on owner
   148→                    pages = owner.client.list_pages(space_id)
   149→                    if pages:
   150→                        page_id = pages[0].get("id", "")
   151→                        print(f"\n  Opening app '{args.app_name}' on owner...")
   152→                        owner.client.open_app(page_id, args.app_name)
   153→            else:
   154→                # No app, just generate owner connection string
   155→                print("\n[5/5] Generating connection string...")
   156→                owner_conn_str = owner.client.get_connection_string()
   157→                owner_details = decode_connection_string(owner_conn_str)
   158→
   159→                print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
   160→                print("  NODE CONNECTION STRING (give this to remote peer)")
   161→                print(f"{'=' * 60}")
   162→                print(f"\n{node_conn_str}\n")
   163→                print(f"{'=' * 60}")
   164→        else:
   165→            print("  WARNING: No nodes found after connect")
   166→
   167→        print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
   168→        print("  READY — waiting for remote peer to connect")
   169→        print("  Press Ctrl+C to stop")
   170→        print(f"{'=' * 60}")
   171→        print(f"\n  Node socket: {node.socket_path}")
   172→        print(f"  Owner socket: {owner.socket_path}")
   173→        print()
   174→
   175→        # Poll and print connection events
   176→        while True:
   177→            try:
   178→                nodes = owner.client.list_nodes()
   179→                for n in nodes:
   180→                    status = "connected" if n.get("is_connected") else "disconnected"
   181→                    print(f"\r  Node {n.get('name', '?')}: {status}    ", end="", flush=True)
   182→            except Exception:
   183→                pass
   184→            time.sleep(5)
   185→
   186→    except KeyboardInterrupt:
   187→        pass
   188→    finally:
   189→        if not keep:
   190→            print("\nCleaning up...")
   191→            scenario.stop()
   192→        else:
   193→            print("\n--keep flag set, instances still running")
   194→
   195→
   196→if __name__ == "__main__":
   197→    main()

1→"""
     2→ControlClient - Socket communication with slint_shell control server
     3→
     4→The control server uses JSON-RPC style protocol:
     5→    Request:  {"method": "eval", "params": {"code": "return 1+1"}, "id": 1}
     6→    Response: {"result": 2, "id": 1}
     7→    Error:    {"error": {"message": "..."}, "id": 1}
     8→"""
     9→
    10→import glob
    11→import socket
    12→import json
    13→import time
    14→from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, Optional
    15→
    16→
    17→class ControlClient:
    18→    """Client for communicating with slint_shell control socket."""
    19→
    20→    def __init__(self, socket_path: str, timeout: float = 30.0):
    21→        """
    22→        Args:
    23→            socket_path: Path to Unix socket (e.g., /tmp/test/owner.sock)
    24→            timeout: Command timeout in seconds
    25→        """
    26→        self.socket_path = socket_path
    27→        self.timeout = timeout
    28→        self._id_counter = 0
    29→
    30→    @classmethod
    31→    def discover(cls, instance_name: str = None, timeout: float = 30.0) -> "ControlClient":
    32→        """Auto-discover a running instance by name.
    33→
    34→        Args:
    35→            instance_name: Instance name (e.g., "owner", "viewer", "node")
    36→                          If None, discovers any available socket
    37→            timeout: Command timeout in seconds
    38→
    39→        Returns:
    40→            ControlClient connected to the discovered socket
    41→
    42→        Raises:
    43→            ConnectionError: If no matching socket found
    44→        """
    45→        pattern = f"/tmp/osvauld-debug-{instance_name or '*'}.sock"
    46→        sockets = glob.glob(pattern)
    47→        if not sockets:
    48→            raise ConnectionError(f"No socket found matching {pattern}")
    49→        return cls(sockets[0], timeout=timeout)
    50→
    51→    def _next_id(self) -> int:
    52→        self._id_counter += 1
    53→        return self._id_counter
    54→
    55→    def wait_until(
    56→        self,
    57→        condition: Callable[[], bool],
    58→        timeout: float = 10.0,
    59→        poll: float = 0.1,
    60→        desc: str = None
    61→    ) -> bool:
    62→        """Wait for a condition to become true.
    63→
    64→        Args:
    65→            condition: Callable that returns True when condition is met
    66→            timeout: Maximum time to wait in seconds
    67→            poll: Polling interval in seconds
    68→            desc: Optional description for timeout error
    69→
    70→        Returns:
    71→            True when condition is met
    72→
    73→        Raises:
    74→            TimeoutError: If condition not met within timeout
    75→        """
    76→        start = time.time()
    77→        while time.time() - start < timeout:
    78→            try:
    79→                if condition():
    80→                    return True
    81→            except Exception:
    82→                pass
    83→            time.sleep(poll)
    84→        raise TimeoutError(desc or "Condition not met within timeout")
    85→
    86→    def wait_for_sync(
    87→        self,
    88→        other: "ControlClient",
    89→        check_code: str,
    90→        timeout: float = 10.0
    91→    ) -> bool:
    92→        """Wait for data to sync to another instance.
    93→
    94→        Args:
    95→            other: The other ControlClient to check
    96→            check_code: Lua code that returns truthy when synced
    97→            timeout: Maximum time to wait
    98→
    99→        Returns:
   100→            True when synced
   101→
   102→        Raises:
   103→            TimeoutError: If sync not complete within timeout
   104→        """
   105→        return self.wait_until(
   106→            lambda: other.eval(check_code),
   107→            timeout=timeout,
   108→            desc=f"Sync to {other.socket_path}"
   109→        )
   110→
   111→    def send(self, method: str, params: Optional[Dict] = None) -> Any:
   112→        """Send a command and return the result.
   113→
   114→        Args:
   115→            method: Command method name (e.g., "eval", "login", "list_spaces")
   116→            params: Optional parameters dict
   117→
   118→        Returns:
   119→            The result field from the response
   120→
   121→        Raises:
   122→            ConnectionError: If socket connection fails
   123→            RuntimeError: If server returns an error
   124→        """
   125→        cmd: Dict[str, Any] = {"method": method, "id": self._next_id()}
   126→        if params:
   127→            cmd["params"] = params
   128→
   129→        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
   130→        try:
   131→            sock.connect(self.socket_path)
   132→            sock.settimeout(self.timeout)
   133→            sock.send((json.dumps(cmd) + '\n').encode())
   134→
   135→            # Read response (may be large)
   136→            chunks = []
   137→            while True:
   138→                chunk = sock.recv(65536)
   139→                if not chunk:
   140→                    break
   141→                chunks.append(chunk.decode())
   142→                # Check if we have complete JSON
   143→                try:
   144→                    response = json.loads(''.join(chunks))
   145→                    break
   146→                except json.JSONDecodeError:
   147→                    continue
   148→
   149→            response = json.loads(''.join(chunks))
   150→        except socket.error as e:
   151→            raise ConnectionError(f"Socket error: {e}")
   152→        finally:
   153→            sock.close()
   154→
   155→        # Check for error
   156→        if "error" in response:
   157→            err = response["error"]
   158→            msg = err.get("message", str(err)) if isinstance(err, dict) else str(err)
   159→            raise RuntimeError(f"{method} failed: {msg}")
   160→
   161→        return response.get("result")
   162→
   163→    # ============================================================
   164→    # Auth commands
   165→    # ============================================================
   166→
   167→    def ping(self) -> bool:
   168→        """Check if the control server is responding."""
   169→        result = self.send("ping")
   170→        return result.get("status") == "ok" if isinstance(result, dict) else False
   171→
   172→    def signup(self, username: str, passphrase: str) -> Dict:
   173→        """Sign up a new user."""
   174→        return self.send("sign_up", {"username": username, "passphrase": passphrase})
   175→
   176→    def login(self, passphrase: str) -> Dict:
   177→        """Login with passphrase."""
   178→        return self.send("login", {"passphrase": passphrase})
   179→
   180→    def signup_or_login(self, username: str, passphrase: str = "test", wait_p2p: bool = True) -> Dict:
   181→        """Sign up if new user, then login.
   182→
   183→        Args:
   184→            username: Username for signup
   185→            passphrase: Passphrase (default: "test")
   186→            wait_p2p: Wait for P2P to initialize after login (default: True)
   187→
   188→        Returns:
   189→            Login result
   190→        """
   191→        try:
   192→            self.signup(username, passphrase)
   193→        except RuntimeError as e:
   194→            # Ignore "user exists" errors
   195→            if "exists" not in str(e).lower():
   196→                raise
   197→        result = self.login(passphrase)
   198→
   199→        # Wait for P2P to initialize
   200→        if wait_p2p:
   201→            import time
   202→            for _ in range(60):  # Up to 30 seconds (polling at 0.5s)
   203→                status = self.p2p_status()
   204→                if status.get("p2p_ready"):
   205→                    break
   206→                time.sleep(0.5)
   207→
   208→        return result
   209→
   210→    # ============================================================
   211→    # Space/Page/App commands
   212→    # ============================================================
   213→
   214→    def create_space_with_pages(self, path: str, name: str = None) -> Dict:
   215→        """Create a space and import pages from path.
   216→
   217→        Args:
   218→            path: Path to app directory (used as template and for page import)
   219→            name: Space name (default: derived from path)

    40→class NodeSession:

    68→    def init(self, username: str, passphrase: str) -> None:

    83→                "init",
    84→                "--username", username,

    96→    def init_and_start(self, username: str = "node", passphrase: str = "test") -> str:

   481→    def wait_for(
   482→        self,
   483→        condition_fn: Callable[[], Any],
   484→        timeout: float = 15.0,
   485→        interval: float = 0.5,
   486→        desc: str = "condition",
   487→    ) -> Any:
   488→        """Poll until condition_fn returns a truthy value.
   489→
   490→        Args:
   491→            condition_fn: Callable returning truthy when done
   492→            timeout: Max seconds to wait
   493→            interval: Polling interval in seconds
   494→            desc: Description for timeout error
   495→
   496→        Returns:
   497→            The truthy value from condition_fn
   498→
   499→        Raises:
   500→            TimeoutError: If condition not met within timeout
   501→        """
   502→        start = time.time()
   503→        while time.time() - start < timeout:
   504→            try:
   505→                result = condition_fn()
   506→                if result:
   507→                    return result
   508→            except Exception:
   509→                pass
   510→            time.sleep(interval)
   511→        raise TimeoutError(f"Timeout waiting for {desc} on '{self.name}' (after {timeout}s)")
